### May 27, 2022
Friend -- Happy Memorial Day Weekend! This weekend, we remember those who have made the ultimate sacrifice in defense of our country, and thank the brave men and women in our lives who continue to serve in the armed forces. We hope you are able to spend this time with loved ones. As we reflect on the highly successful 2022 State Convention in Middleton this past weekend, we are excited about the road ahead of November. If you would like to join our efforts to re-elect Senator Ron Johnson, defeat Tony Evers, and elect conservatives at all levels of the ballot, sign up to volunteer [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VsLgeNFrtuHusRivV19v3aCXxtdEYxug7BpyM8N6AZw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_27_22_v1&n=2). As always, thanks for all you do! \- Team WisGOP |
Last weekend, the WisGOP held our successful 2022 State Convention in Middleton, which was the most well-attended Republican convention in a decade! Ultimately, nearly 1,600 Wisconsin conservatives gathered in the belly of the beast in Dane County to share in conversations, hear from elected officials and candidates, and attend training sessions as we prepare for the election year ahead. Grassroots attendees also signaled their desire to allow statewide candidates to continue to make their case to voters ahead of the August primary while enthusiastically endorsing Senator Ron Johnson for re-election. You can watch the WisEye recording of the morning session [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=cBQK0qmnvGef24E_uueTKqaB_eXWUtINlnuyXdaSXXIn_8AcFd08eohkLbRdPB1idM55hLFC18MjeGmuFPxQSEzVUBiH3PsWXouHYxX2WU-t6kUnPi_HtHrG5PZ9j_ah-gNrVsRlUYYbDUWSLzHD9A&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_27_22_v1&n=3) and the afternoon session [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=cBQK0qmnvGef24E_uueTKqaB_eXWUtINlnuyXdaSXXIn_8AcFd08eohkLbRdPB1idM55hLFC18MjeGmuFPxQSEzVUBiH3PsWXouHYxX2WU_ZYSF_h71jyI0l_-TVxvPeH6Qi24ZP5-Fu6uR6uXBvCQ&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_27_22_v1&n=4).
| | A new Marquette University Law School poll shows that Joe Biden’s approval remains abysmal in Wisconsin. According to [**Empower Wisconsin**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=hzZHoe_LqjIxZeEPQX1TwFy3rg9AUtiTc7KDnUZeywzOBIvnDWDHKvj1X_J-hK90gU1FY0n2bM1Cy7nav3QdTzfCzQTIBIH2ajOCwc2P5waEpNxU7c98Sk1vKSHOup4N&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_27_22_v1&n=5) , “Biden’s approval rating in the Badger State stands at an abysmal 42%, with 57% of respondents disapproving of his performance...The Democrat’s approval rating is at its lowest level, plummeting 16 percentage points since his high water mark of 58% (42% disapproval) in July. He’s been under water since September.” Given the continuation of historic inflation and a crippled supply chain, it’s no surprise that Biden isn’t winning favor in the Badger State.

### **In Case You Missed It...**
### _[**Statement on Evers’ Delayed Request to Wisconsin Parole Commission**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0R72aAQRdpUWAFwuxNARiAWtPQgk2yieEZ8mdwKaCv5BaCnwy2zknwfLXfJeaD7phFNqs4Azxz_6OZsgRQXcTUXDbhCKnZSYSHQY8HYc2ajf&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_27_22_v1&n=8)_
Tony Evers has faced increased pressure and refused to answer questions on the decision by his Wisconsin Parole Board Chairman, John Tate, to parole a convicted murderer who who served less than 25 years of his 80-year sentence. This comes after Evers also dodged questions on whether he planned to fire John Chisholm and ultimately refused to hold him accountable. It shouldn’t have taken widespread public outrage for Tony Evers to finally consider doing the right thing, but Evers simply hasn’t taken public safety seriously and has given criminals more consideration than victims.
### _[**Wisconsin Family Action Attack Follows Inflammatory Rhetoric by Democrats**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0SHM6NZdaLwb4FpzLRYIsC2ZyFoqkVoJBgutqV9zL3jhOYVsh3FkXJXGpYUJ8fGSPaI4k0NrJXVzsNdy6Saz7TaZa9TddcVg_ResxX2Ab1G3&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_27_22_v1&n=9)_
Earlier this month, the Madison office of pro-life group Wisconsin Family Action was vandalized and attacked by arson likely in response to the leaked draft of the U.S. Supreme Court opinion that would overturn Roe v. Wade. Democrats in Wisconsin have been in lockstep with their national counterparts, hoping to use the leaked opinion to inflame their most radical voters. In fact, when asked about the protests at the homes of Supreme Court justices, White House press secretary Jen Psaki refused to condemn these threats to public safety.
### _[**Liberal Hacks Define “Health Care” for Tony Evers**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0ZhCPq3LybqcFtZQrrrD0wpkemw3qvTXwrtCYbnx0mUGGLViiDdq6uyHwLsgOdQXdhR7JgADHc8aprsYTEQa7xg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_27_22_v1&n=10)_
While Tony Evers tries to pass off social engineering and big government programs as “health care,” he’s angering actual health care workers to the point of resignation. The Wisconsin State Journal reported on Tony Evers and Mandela Barnes’ so-called “Health Equity Council.” The group, which is primarily comprised of Democrat donors, is calling for government handouts and new taxpayer-funded offices for “environmental justice” and “transgender health and safety” under the banner of “health care.” This comes after Evers’ efforts to impose government-run health care in his most recent budget.

name: Lt. General Jack Bergman, USMC
subject: More Than Remember
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bergman for
body:
Peter,
On Memorial Day, we remember those who gave
the ultimate sacrifice in defense of our nation and our freedom.
As someone who served his country, this is
something that is front and center in my mind-and in my heart-24
hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.
Sadly, too many have forgotten that freedom
is never free.
When you return me to Congress I will
continue to honor the memories of the fallen by prioritizing the
needs of our veterans and those who served over illegal
immigrants. And I will always work to protect ALL of America's
freedoms from ALL enemies-foreign and domestic.
Please help me honor their sacrifice with
your $25 donation today!
The sacrifice made by these patriots during
our nation's many fights for freedom was not made for
partisanship, but too many here in Washington misunderstand the
importance of patriotism and the sacrifice of those who were
willing to lay down their lives for their country and the values
we hold so dearly.
The many freedoms we enjoy and that make us
different from every nation on the planet came with a cost. It's
why we cannot allow OUR RIGHTS-from free speech to our gun rights
to our right to free and fair elections be trampled on by ANYONE.
As a 40-year Veteran of the United States
Marine Corps and the highest-ranking combat Veteran serving in
Congress. My oath to defend our nation didn't end when I hung up
my uniform and I will continue to stand up to Joe Biden's
overreach that is transforming America into an unrecognizable
nation.
As long as I draw breath, I will fight to
ensure that the memory of the brave souls who gave it all for our
nation in the name of patriotism was never in vain. Anything
less would be un-American and an affront to those with whom I
served.
I need your help to honor their sacrifice.
Please donate today!
Never forget,
Rep. Jack Bergman (MI-1)Lt. General, U.S.M.C.
(ret.)

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0490m6d1l8871gqseh63fk8gqacbi4mag033fb8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ugqm4tbj6gor7crieipnct5jeqpmed1jehh3eohgmjhn6t30mqr7cs3he9jr7c37q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhmapmac3im9j38o5jc1jr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5cpjmcoj0c9g649fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp9i69ehv4l9ch7umgpu5r63sg60tb3mgkmqia10_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o32c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zctp0b1cvck00ed2fof88d67n63b37l1a77jamd8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o32c1h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. [View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8tijj08gc6506fmb8nla53ll443b7j1pskl52jg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf4o5gm4q33d1ks8rr2dj6ceqbathnmlib2pdlcsp73d76cuor2slhmuob6sbh6srt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor5cr561pb4phkcipm8dtgmlin48d245p25oh4cdimcpr6c9g68pb24no)

---
Dear Conservative, Why does Mitch McConnell hate my guts? Why has McConnell poured over $12 million into my home state of Alabama, with the goal of trying to destroy my conservative record? **This is Congressman Mo Brooks. I'm one of the**** _most conservative_****members of the United States House of Representatives. ** For over a decade in Congress, I’ve fought socialist liberals who are trying to destroy our country, and weak-kneed, debt junky RINOs who are addicted to big spending, and just want their place at the trough. They’re afraid of the media, and afraid to stand up and do what’s right. I’ve been a thorn in their side in the House, and will absolutely stand on principle in the Senate. Mitch McConnell knows that, and that’s why he’s determined to stop me. He’s already poured millions into my race, and with just four weeks until Election Day, the attacks are ramping up. I desperately need your help
---
[**DONATE NOW >>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z16vuif9q0lhqrhq5ktnjn66e9m25jesjod36l1o_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o34clh2bs)
---
[**You can tell a lot about a person by who their friends are. My friends Ted Cruz, Rand Paul, Marjorie Taylor Green and Jim Jordan ALL have endorsed my campaign and are working to help me.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlq2rpev4emh7mmfbqrndd00lg3adv6pl7l0smtg_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o34clh2bs) I'll shoot straight with you: the GOP establishment leadership has **NEVER** liked me, not even for even one day. I've made their lives pretty miserable, whether it's standing up to them for their illegal immigration giveaways when they try to help the Chamber of Commerce import more cheap labor to compete with American workers, or their OUTRAGEOUS government spending, I've been a world-class pain in the neck for RINOs. Mitch McConnell knows this, and that's why he is hell-bent on making sure I am _never_ seated in the United States Senate. When I ran for Senate in a special election to replace Jeff Sessions in 2017,_**McConnell spent over $9 MILLION**_ dollars to defeat me in my Alabama Republican Primary--and we almost won!
---
[**JOIN THEM SUPPORT MO BROOKS >>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm8dqjte3gle35shh83kjq4pa459nvj7q306vmk8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o34clh2bs)
---
My friend, in order for you to understand why this race is so very important, you need to know the situation we have right now in Washington: the battle lines are drawn in 3 directions on Capitol Hill: On one side, you've got the _"Big Government, Big Business, pro-illegal aliens, pro-big spending"_**** Republicans, led by _Mitch McConnell,_ and the Washington GOP establishment. **These people hate Donald Trump, they hate his voters, and wish we would all go away so that they can get back to business as usual.** On another side, you've got Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, AOC, The Squad, and the most liberal Democratic Party in American history. **These people hate America and are hostile to her. They hate America's history. They believe that America is the "bad guy" in the world and that America has to be fundamentally remade. What's more, they hate working people, they hate our values, they hate every single thing that we stand for. **
---
[**DRAIN THE SWAMP >>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zso465cku9q4otk1d6jp1v7d897revq29icjj3kg_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o34clh2bs)
---
And then finally, in the smallest minority in Washington, you've got conservatives like me: **ROCK SOLID** , Donald Trump, America First, pro-life, pro-gun, pro-religious freedom, small government conservatives who are sick of the radical left and their attempts to remake this country, and also JUST AS SICK of the Big Government RINO crowd who enables them!
---
[**SUPPORT GRASSROOT CONSERVATIVES**** >>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztpk2orqciften5vtjhfm2jgkrv7d3k17l3gigng_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o34clh2bs)
---
There aren't enough of us in DC, but you know who we are: Patriots like Rand Paul, and Jim Jordan and Ted Cruz, and yes, DONALD TRUMP and DONALD TRUMP Jr. Those are the battle lines, my friend. Those are the stakes. For way too long, I've heard conservatives say, "What do I care who wins a primary in a red state like Kansas, or Missouri, or Alabama?" Well, THIS is why, right here. Please read this next line carefully, because it's the most important thing I'm going to say in this whole letter to you: **EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE.** Let me say that again: [**EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4makinfbgeqc23dsu12mt0s4vqubm6femf30pto_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o34clh2bs) Even if we gain control of the Senate, if we don't have solid conservatives in the Senate, if we have moderates like Mitch McConnell, Mitt Romney, and Susan Collins calling the tune, we will still _always_ lose. They will sell us out, they will fail, and then, to add insult to injury, they will blame conservatives. That's why we MUST win primaries in Red States. That's why we must have a new majority leader. **And that's why it's so critically important that I win this Senate race in Alabama.** [**But I can't do that without you. I need your support, because McConnell and his allies are already on TV in Alabama supporting my opponents. **](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6hc1tqja4luivgss6jmvtn9e7krfkgc7tlapvn0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctj64o34clh2bs) Quite simply, we are outgunned by the amount of money being shoveled from Washington, DC into Alabama. My friend, we are headed into the stretch run of this battle in Alabama, a battle for the heart and soul of the Republican Party, and for the United States Senate. subject: Two Big Wins against Discrimination!
body:
Census Bureau Audit Reveals Criminals on the Payroll

[INSIDE JW]

COURT DECLARES CALIFORNIA’S CORPORATE BOARD GENDER QUOTAS
UNCONSTITUTIONAL

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27402&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmlkZW9zL2ltbWVkaWF0ZS1hcm1lZC1yZXNwb25zZS1zYXZlcy1saXZlcy1pbi1tYXNzLXNob290aW5ncy1oaWxsYXJ5LWF1dGhvcml6ZWQtYW50aS10cnVtcC1kb3NzaWVyLW1vcmUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]

A big victory for us and California: A court has found California’s
gender quota law for corporate boards unconstitutional. The verdict
comes after a 28-day trial (_Robin Crest et al. v. Alex Padilla_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=14906&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NyZXN0LWV0LWFsLXYtcGFkaWxsYS13b21lbi1vbi1ib2FyZHMtY29tcGxhaW50LTI3NTYxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==]
(Case No. 19STCV27561)).

This verdict follows a similar ruling
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27068&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2EtY291cnQtb3Bpbmlvbi1leHBsYWlucy1oaXN0b3JpYy1ydWxpbmcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]
in our favor last month that found California’s diversity mandate
for corporate boards unconstitutional.

We filed the gender quota lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27378&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY291cnQtZGVjbGFyZXMtdW5jb25zdGl0dXRpb25hbC1jYWxpZm9ybmlhLWdlbmRlci1xdW90YS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=]
in Los Angeles County Superior Court in 2019 on behalf of California
taxpayers Robin Crest, Earl De Vries and Judy De Vries. The lawsuit
challenges a 2018 law, known as Senate Bill 826, which requires every
publicly held corporation headquartered in California to have at least
one director “who self-identifies her gender as a woman” on its
board of directors by December 31, 2019.

The law also required corporations to have up to three such persons on
their boards by December 31, 2021, depending on the size of the board.
We argued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=26424&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkaWNpYWwtd2F0Y2gtc3Vlcy1jYWxpZm9ybmlhLW92ZXItZ2VuZGVyLXF1b3RhLW1hbmRhdGUtZm9yLWNvcnBvcmF0ZS1ib2FyZHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]
that the quota for women on corporate boards violates the Equal
Protection Clause of the California Constitution.

California Superior Court Judge Maureen Duffy-Lewis agreed with us and
“determine[d] that SB 826 violates the Equal Protection Clause of
the California Constitution and is thus enjoined.”

In the court’s 23-page verdict
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27362&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NyZXN0LXYtcGFkaWxsYS12ZXJkaWN0LWNhLW1heS0yMDIyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==],
it specifically found that “S.B. 826’s goal was to achieve general
equity or parity; its goal was not to boost California’s economy,
not to improve opportunities for women in the workplace nor not to
protect California taxpayers, public employees, pensions and
retirees.” Further, the court found that “putting more women on
boards demonstrated that the Legislature’s actual purpose was
gender-balancing, not remedying discrimination.” “There is no
Compelling Governmental interest in remedying discrimination in the
board selection process because neither the Legislature nor Defendant
could identify any specific, purposeful, intentional and unlawful
discrimination to be remedied,” Judge Duffy-Lewis said.

Basically, what the court did was eviscerate California’s
unconstitutional gender quota mandate. This is the second California
court decision finding that quotas for corporate boards are
unconstitutional. The radical Left’s unprecedented attacks on
anti-discrimination law has suffered another stinging defeat.

Thankfully, California courts have upheld the core American value of
equal protection under the law. Our taxpayer clients are heroes for
standing up for civil rights against the Left’s pernicious efforts
to undo anti-discrimination protections. We have helped protect the
civil rights of every American with these successful lawsuits.

LAWSUIT AGAINST CHICAGO MAYOR ENDS ALONG WITH HER RACIST INTERVIEW
POLICY

We struck a blow against official racial discrimination in Chicago.

Our federal civil rights lawsuit on behalf of the Daily Caller News
Foundation and reporter Thomas Catenacci against Chicago Mayor Lori
Lightfoot was dismissed after Lightfoot said she will not limit
one-on-one interviews to “journalists of color” in the future
(_Catenacci et al v. Lightfoot_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=24999&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhdGVuYWNjaS1ldC1hbC12LWxpZ2h0Zm9vdC1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI4NTIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]
(No. 1:21-cv-02852)).

In dismissing the case, our attorneys noted
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27403&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhdGVuYWNjaS12LWxpZ2h0Zl06P3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz

As testified to by her Communications Director and as stated in her
motion to dismiss, Mayor Lori Lightfoot has no plans or intentions in
the future to exclusively provide one-on-one interviews with
journalists of color.
We filed the civil rights lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27359&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbGlnaHRmb290X2NvbXBsYWludC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=]
against Lightfoot
on May 27, 2021, after Catenacci, a white journalist, emailed
Lightfoot’s office requesting a one-on-one interview with the mayor.
The mayor’s office never replied to the request or to two additional
follow-up emails from Catenacci. Catenacci’s request came on one of
the days that the mayor admittedly was discriminating against
journalists based on race.

On May 18, 2021, Mayor Lightfoot’s office informed multiple
reporters that she would grant one-on-one interviews, “only to Black
or Brown Journalists
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=24997&F=T&
The next day, the mayor released a letter
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=24998&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL21heW9yLWxpZ2h0Zm9vdC1qb3VybmFsaXN0cy0yMDIxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==]
confirming her discriminatory policy. Our lawsuit alleged that
Lightfoot’s refusal to be interviewed by Catenacci was a violation
of the Daily Caller News Foundation’s and his First Amendment rights
and Catenacci’s right to equal protection.

On July 26, 2021, after the lawsuit was filed, Mayor Lightfoot told
_The New York Times_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=25446&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubnl0aW1lcy5jb20vMjAyMS8wNy8yNi9vcGluaW9uL3N3YXkta2FyYS1maXNoZXItbG9yaS1saWdodGZvb3QuaHRtbD91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==]
that she would “absolutely” engage in racial discrimination again.
When pressed on the issue by our attorneys, her spokesperson testified
under oath
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27379&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhdGVuYWNjaS12LWxpZ2h0Zm9vdC1kZXBvc2l0aW9uLXRyYW5zY3JpcHQtbWFyY2gtMy0yMDIyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==]
in this lawsuit that Mayor Lightfoot promised not to engage in any
more of this type of racial discrimination:

Q Okay. Have you spoken to the Mayor about whether she intends to
exclusively provide one-on-one interviews with journalists of color in
the future?

A Yes.

Q Okay. What did the Mayor tell you about that?

A She does not have plans to do so.

Q Does she intend to do so?

A No.
Mayor Lightfoot’s attorneys also told
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27360&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhdGVuYWNjaS12LWxpZ2h0Zm9vdC1tb3Rpb24tdG8tZGlzbWlzcy0wMjg1Mi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=]
the court the same thing in their most recent filing.
“I’m glad that Mayor Lightfoot finally realized that her racist
policy was untenable. I hope all elected officials take note of our
case and think twice before issuing similar policies,” Thomas
Catenacci said.

“It’s amazing and sad that we had to do this in America 2022. A
government official discriminating based on race is as wrong as it
gets. We are relieved that she finally relented,” Daily Caller News
Foundation President Neil Patel said.

It is incredible, in this day and age, that it took a federal civil
rights lawsuit to force Chicago Mayor Lori Lightfoot to retreat from
her racial discrimination against reporters.

CENSUS BUREAU KEEPS HIRING ‘UNSUITABLE INDIVIDUALS’ WITH CRIMINAL
RECORDS

The federal government seems to have little or no interest in
protecting you from felons it hires to conduct the census. Our
_Corruption Chronicles_ blog explains
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27369&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2Vuc3VzLWJ1cmVhdS1oaXJpbmctaW5kaXZpZHVhbHMtd2l0aC1jcmltaW5hbC1yZWNvcmRzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==]
that this has gone on for years with no corrective action.

Thirteen years after a federal investigation
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27380&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ2FvLmdvdi9hc3NldHMvZ2FvLTEwLTEzMnQucGRmP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]
blasted the U.S. Census
Bureau for hiring criminals to enter American homes to gather
statistics for the decennial count, a new audit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27381&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub2lnLmRvYy5nb3YvT0lHUHVibGljYXRpb25zL09JRy0yMi0wMjEtSShSRURBQ1RFRCkucGRmP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]
reveals the disturbing practice continues. In fact, more than a decade
after the problem was exposed workers for the 2020 count were not
properly vetted and many with criminal records had direct interactions
with the public. The most recent probe, conducted by the Department of
Commerce Inspector General, found that “dozens of employees who
worked on address canvassing in advance of the 2020 census had major
issues flagged on their investigations, which typically means
employees are automatically disqualified from their federal jobs.”

Chunks of the 28-page report are redacted but the gist is well
conveyed, that the Census Bureau has long failed to screen its
workforce and therefore endangers the public. It’s not like there
isn’t a vetting system in place. When one of the 248 regional
offices recruit a candidate, the Census Investigative Services (CIS)
at the agency’s headquarters in Suitland, Maryland is charged with
conducting a pre-employment suitability review. The process includes
sending fingerprints to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and
a credit history as well as self-disclosed criminal record to CIS for
review. Nevertheless, the Bureau still hires felons—including sex
offenders—at regional offices nationwide. As an example, a few years
ago the Charlotte, North Carolina Area Census Office (ACO) employed a
man convicted of a felony
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27382&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2Vuc3VzLWJ1cmVhdS1zdGlsbC1oaXJpbmctZmVsb25zLWNoaWxkLXNleC1vZmZlbmRlcnMtcGFzcy1iYWNrZ3JvdW5kLWNoZWNrLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==]
involving sex with a child as a regional recruiting manager because
despite his criminal record, he passed the Census Bureau’s
background check.

The Bureau’s negligent security practices have been on the radar of
federal lawmakers for years. Over a decade ago, Congressional
investigators slammed the agency for failing to adequately conduct
mandatory background checks for tens of thousands of workers,
resulting in the hiring of hundreds of violent criminals. At the time,
the probe found that more than 35,000 temporary census workers were
employed without the proper criminal background check, which includes
fingerprinting. That means that more than one-fifth of the canvassing
workforce did not get properly processed or fully screened for
employment eligibility, creating an obvious security risk. More than
200 of those were subsequently determined to have criminal records yet
were in constant contact with the public while canvassing for the 2010
census. Investigators said the criminal record checks were bungled
because the Census Bureau’s incompetent staff was poorly trained to
conduct them.

Twelve years ago Judicial Watch reported
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27383&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2Vuc3VzLWhpcmVzLXNleC1vZmZlbmRlci1ob21lLXZpc2l0cy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=]
that the Census Bureau knowingly hired a registered sex offender with
a long criminal history to make home visits even though such convicts
are banned from working for the agency. The embarrassing gaffe came to
light when a young mother in a New Jersey suburb recognized the census
worker who came to her home from the state’s registered sex offender
database. She initially thought it was safe to provide the man with
information because he was a legitimate government worker with a badge
and bag sporting the U.S. Census Bureau’s official logo. Incredibly,
the sex offender used a fake name to get the census job but failed a
fingerprint check after getting hired. The agency still let him to
complete four days of training and allowed him to visit homes even
though he did not pass the background check.

The latest audit, released last week, shows that virtually nothing has
changed after all these years and that the Bureau has done little to
improve its derelict hiring practices. Investigators found that at
least 6,802 census workers were not properly adjudicated, “resulting
in persons with significant issues working for the Bureau and, in some
instances, contacting households during the 2020 Census NRFU
[Nonresponse Followup] operation.” In cases when CIS adjudicators
actually vetted employees, the watchdog found that they often failed
to request necessary documentation to assess the severity of the
issues raised. Stressing that background checks are a critical process
to help protect the nation’s interests by establishing trust in the
federal workforce, the IG points out the obvious in its recent report:
“The lack of oversight increases the risk of unknowingly allowing
unsuitable individuals into positions of public trust, which could
cause harm to the bureau.”

HISTORIC JUDICIAL WATCH GERRYMANDER WIN COULD SET NATIONAL PRECEDENT

Mapping congressional districts to make it easier for one party to win
is hardly a new practice, but lately the courts have been throttling
the politicians' schemes. Michael Morrison, our chief investigative
reporter, provides an overview
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27384&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaGlzdG9yaWMtanctZ2VycnltYW5kZXItd2luLWNvdWxkLXNldC1uYXRpb25hbC1wcmVjZWRlbnQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]
in _Investigative Bulletin_:

The judge was not pulling any punches. Siding with Judicial Watch in a
challenge to a congressional redistricting plan cooked up by Democrats
dominating the Maryland state legislature, Judge Lynne
Battaglia—herself a Democrat—threw haymakers. The Democrat
redistricting map was an “extreme partisan gerrymander.” Democrats
had attempted to “suppress the voice of Republican voters.” It was
drawn up with “partisanship as predominant intent.” It violated
state constitutional provisions on equal protection and free speech.
It subordinated “constitutional criteria to political
consideration.”

It was out. Making history—for the first time, a Maryland court
ruled that a congressional redistricting plan violated the state
constitution—Judge Battaglia banned the use of the gerrymander map
and ordered the Maryland General Assembly back to the drawing board.

Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton hailed the decision. “This key
court victory against abusive partisan gerrymandering by Democrats in
Maryland could set a national precedent,” he said. Maryland Governor
Larry Hogan called it “an historic milestone.”

Judicial Watch filed the lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=26523&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctc3Vlcy1tZC1nZXJyeW1hbmRlcmluZy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=]
on behalf
of twelve Maryland voters who objected to the state legislature’s
plan and was joined at trial by a second set of plaintiffs. The
argument? The gerrymandered maps diminished their right to participate
in a free and fair election on an equal basis with other Maryland
voters. The court agreed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27355&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubWFyeWxhbmRtYXR0ZXJzLm9yZy8yMDIyLzAzLzI1L2p1ZGdlLXRocm93cy1vdXQtY29uZ3Jlc3Npb25hbC1tYXAtb3JkZXJzLWxlZ2lzbGF0dXJlLXRvLXRyeS1hZ2Fpbi1uZXh0LXdlZWsvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz].

The March ruling has begun to echo through the national debate. In New
York, in April, the state’s highest court rejected a new
redistricting map favored by Democrats dominating state politics. The
court ruled that the map violated a state prohibition on partisan
gerrymandering, saying it was created with “impermissible partisan
purpose.” Court observers say the Maryland case was discussed in
briefings and oral arguments in New York.

In 2019, the Supreme Court rejected political gerrymandering claims
brought solely under the federal Constitution. Since then, the battle
over redistricting has spread to state courts throughout the country.
According to experts surveyed by Judicial Watch, cases related to
gerrymandering and redistricting are underway in nineteen states.
Among the states are the electoral powerhouses Texas, Florida,
Georgia, Wisconsin, Michigan, and Ohio. You can read about some of the
upcoming cases here
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27356&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9yZWRpc3RyaWN0aW5nLmxscy5lZHUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz].

Tough anti-gerrymandering measures are one way to start cleaning up
dirty election practices, says Robert Popper, Judicial Watch’s
director of voting integrity efforts. Gerrymandering is a “method of
cheating [that] has been around for 200 years,” Popper told
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59005&L=27357&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly90aW1jYXN0LmNvbS9uZXdzL2V4Y2x1c2l2ZS1tYXJ5bGFuZC1jb3VydC1ydWxlcy1hZ2FpbnN0LWRlbW9jcmF0cy1pbi1nZXJyeW1hbmRlcmluZy1jYXNlLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==]
journalist Tim Pool. “If you’re a state that doesn’t have an
anti-gerrymandering provision, then suddenly it’s a political issue.
Why don’t you? You want districts that are ugly and screwed up for
partisan advantage, you want to cheat opponents in state elections.”

In Maryland, the state legislature quickly capitulated in the face of
the court ruling and signed on to a new, fairer redistricting map. In
New York, redistricting has been turned over to a special master. But
Popper warns of trouble in states where political gerrymandering
survives, with partisan operatives possibly turning to “new,
computer-generated maps” that could become “so convoluted that’s
it’s effectively like you don’t have a district at all.” We’re
not there yet, says Popper. “But if we don’t deal with
gerrymandering, my prediction is, that’s coming.”

MEMORIAL DAY – WHY WE FIGHT

Memorial Day helps our nation focus on the ultimate sacrifice of
untold numbers of fellow Americans – Americans who gave their lives
to preserve and defend our God-given freedoms and our constitutional
republic.

As we honor those heroes, I’d like to draw your attention again to
the Veterans Day speech given in 1985 by then-President Ronald Reagan.
Much of his speech applies to Memorial Day, especially this portion,
which remains timely today:

And the living have a responsibility to remember the conditions that
led to the wars in which our heroes died. Perhaps we can start by
remembering this: that all of those who died for us and our country
were, in one way or another, victims of a peace process that failed;
victims of a decision to forget certain things; to forget, for
instance, that the surest way to keep a peace going is to stay strong.

Weakness, after all, is a temptation — it tempts the pugnacious to
assert themselves — but strength is a declaration that cannot be
misunderstood. Strength is a condition that declares actions have
consequences. Strength is a prudent warning to the belligerent that
aggression need not go unanswered.

Peace fails when we forget what we stand for. It fails when we forget
that our Republic is based on firm principles, principles that have
real meaning, that with them, we are the last, best hope of man on
Earth; without them, we’re little more than the crust of a
continent. Peace also fails when we forget to bring to the bargaining
table God’s first intellectual gift to man: common sense. Common
sense gives us a realistic knowledge of human beings and how they
think, how they live in the world, what motivates them. Common sense
tells us that man has magic in him, but also clay. Common sense can
tell the difference between right and wrong. Common sense forgives
error, but it always recognizes it to be error first.

We endanger the peace and confuse all issues when we obscure the
truth; when we refuse to name an act for what it is; when we refuse to
see the obvious and seek safety in Almighty. Peace is only maintained
and won by those who have clear eyes and brave minds.

I’d like to think many Americans have “clear eyes and brave
minds” and these patriots desire the same qualities in our political
and judicial leaders. It certainly reflects Judicial Watch’s modest
approach to our efforts.
Have a safe and blessed Memorial Day!

Until next week ...

The verdict comes after a 28-day trial (Robin Crest et al. v. Alex Padilla [==] (Case No. 19STCV27561)). This verdict follows a similar ruling [] in our favor last month that found California’s diversity mandate for corporate boards unconstitutional. We filed the gender quota lawsuit [=] in Los Angeles County Superior Court in 2019 on behalf of California taxpayers Robin Crest, Earl De Vries and Judy De Vries. The lawsuit challenges a 2018 law, known as Senate Bill 826, which requires every publicly held corporation headquartered in California to have at least one director “who self-identifies her gender as a woman” on its board of directors by December 31, 2019. The law also required corporations to have up to three such persons on their boards by December 31, 2021, depending on the size of the board. We argued [] that the quota for women on corporate boards violates the Equal Protection Clause of the California Constitution. California Superior Court Judge Maureen Duffy-Lewis agreed with us and “determine[d] that SB 826 violates the Equal Protection Clause of the California Constitution and is thus enjoined.” In the court’s 23-page verdict [==], it specifically found that “S.B. 826’s goal was to achieve general equity or parity; its goal was not to boost California’s economy, not to improve opportunities for women in the workplace nor not to protect California taxpayers, public employees, pensions and retirees.” Further, the court found that “putting more women on boards demonstrated that the Legislature’s actual purpose was gender-balancing, not remedying discrimination.” “There is no Compelling Governmental interest in remedying discrimination in the board selection process because neither the Legislature nor Defendant could identify any specific, purposeful, intentional and unlawful discrimination to be remedied,” Judge Duffy-Lewis said. Basically, what the court did was eviscerate California’s unconstitutional gender quota mandate. This is the second California court decision finding that quotas for corporate boards are unconstitutional. The radical Left’s unprecedented attacks on anti-discrimination law has suffered another stinging defeat. Thankfully, California courts have upheld the core American value of equal protection under the law. Our taxpayer clients are heroes for standing up for civil rights against the Left’s pernicious efforts to undo anti-discrimination protections. We have helped protect the civil rights of every American with these successful lawsuits. In dismissing the case, our attorneys noted [ As testified to by her Communications Director and as stated in her motion to dismiss, Mayor Lori Lightfoot has no plans or intentions in the future to exclusively provide one-on-one interviews with journalists of color. We filed the civil rights lawsuit [=] against Lightfoot on May 27, 2021, after Catenacci, a white journalist, emailed Lightfoot’s office requesting a one-on-one interview with the mayor. The mayor’s office never replied to the request or to two additional follow-up emails from Catenacci. Catenacci’s request came on one of the days that the mayor admittedly was discriminating against journalists based on race. On May 18, 2021, Mayor Lightfoot’s office informed multiple reporters that she would grant one-on-one interviews, “only to Black or Brown Journalists [= The next day, the mayor released a letter [==] confirming her discriminatory policy. Our lawsuit alleged that Lightfoot’s refusal to be interviewed by Catenacci was a violation of the Daily Caller News Foundation’s and his First Amendment rights and Catenacci’s right to equal protection. A She does not have plans to do so. Q Does she intend to do so? Our Corruption Chronicles blog explains [==] that this has gone on for years with no corrective action. Thirteen years after a federal investigation [] blasted the U.S. Census Bureau for hiring criminals to enter American homes to gather statistics for the decennial count, a new audit [] reveals the disturbing practice continues. The most recent probe, conducted by the Department of Commerce Inspector General, found that “dozens of employees who worked on address canvassing in advance of the 2020 census had major issues flagged on their investigations, which typically means employees are automatically disqualified from their federal jobs.” Chunks of the 28-page report are redacted but the gist is well conveyed, that the Census Bureau has long failed to screen its workforce and therefore endangers the public. It’s not like there isn’t a vetting system in place. When one of the 248 regional offices recruit a candidate, the Census Investigative Services (CIS) at the agency’s headquarters in Suitland, Maryland is charged with conducting a pre-employment suitability review. The process includes sending fingerprints to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and a credit history as well as self-disclosed criminal record to CIS for review. Nevertheless, the Bureau still hires felons—including sex offenders—at regional offices nationwide. As an example, a few years ago the Charlotte, North Carolina Area Census Office (ACO) employed a man convicted of a felony [==] involving sex with a child as a regional recruiting manager because despite his criminal record, he passed the Census Bureau’s background check. The Bureau’s negligent security practices have been on the radar of federal lawmakers for years. Over a decade ago, Congressional investigators slammed the agency for failing to adequately conduct mandatory background checks for tens of thousands of workers, resulting in the hiring of hundreds of violent criminals. At the time, the probe found that more than 35,000 temporary census workers were employed without the proper criminal background check, which includes fingerprinting. That means that more than one-fifth of the canvassing workforce did not get properly processed or fully screened for employment eligibility, creating an obvious security risk. More than 200 of those were subsequently determined to have criminal records yet were in constant contact with the public while canvassing for the 2010 census. Investigators said the criminal record checks were bungled because the Census Bureau’s incompetent staff was poorly trained to conduct them. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, “” has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. This week, Governor DeSantis announced the launch of the Florida Hometown Heroes Housing Program, designed to help Floridians in over 50 critical professions purchase their first home. The program is available to Floridians, including law enforcement officers, firefighters, educators, healthcare professionals, childcare employees, and active military or veterans.
_**" Our hometown heroes are the backbone of Florida communities and making sure that they can afford to be homeowners is a great way to give back to them and support the future of the American dream." - Governor Ron DeSantis**_

Did you know America's favorite Governor has a long history with America's favorite pastime? Governor DeSantis competed in the Little League World Series in 1991 and went on to be the captain of his college varsity baseball team.

Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqlqojpoobk1o7g59a9ela3vnrn4vvtsg0gk26jo_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctgm8o32c5h2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zivjqo26butncqf98lso0l8lkp83slai1jakg748_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctgm8o32c5h2bs) Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zapkoo3atuh9osq1gh61k8dvi7i4lp6n3c2efffo_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctgm8o32c5h2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

| VA Delegate John McGuire
I'm running for State Senate so we can un-California Virginia.
Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner)

| Please Pray
---
|
---
| Our children are #1. There is no doubt America is experiencing a spiritual crises. Those who ridicule us for saying thoughts and prayers tells us much. The massacre that left 19 children and two adults dead in Texas is EXTREMELY heartbreaking. To succeed as a country we must be a moral nation. Evil does exist and we must be vigilant. Let's keep an eye on each other. If you see something, say something, and do something. The breakdown of the family, homes without a father, removal of prayer from school, and politicians who have declared war on our police have caused many of the problems we are experiencing. Next year I will again introduce my SRO (armed officer) requirement in every school bill (dems voted no) and will look into including a price cap for private schools to equal or not exceed what public schools pay, and more. Guns do not kill people, people kill people. England banned guns years ago yet London's murder rate exceeded New York in 2018 so the mayor banned knives [read here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013L-Ad9ZM8gSNPUCuj-Mwv_bfh2o-ZAJprenhNzfPF2u4Yv0SAt-_KqsSavLHWt-oJ3m6rWry2asgTsrXgWOJ-7P-lAyeSmHJD1d1Qcx6wlxc3ZjN9_H2J8KCPb0YvFVn6CbkD_jl1wYsGBVbXn8yiSRa5y4tDjBBR1o-6ecomEL_DYIOVYnHPMlkNZ3xwIvbr2oMupSNFCQgYjKjc6ThyZEzVONIcRb4GCsGdw7qjHJmZkpQssFZI3oNzGRAiFvOYs5pTV9EE4AGEXu9lLRWYqAfQkr5dVG2LI8xsSOKq7cY5S8MdgErMr9AQ-Qa6Hx7GEkbpvOtwXlLn0aND57iNRrnza0KAV_do-U5l9ck7C7wNbZ_vIXEzicYvDYkCErYkY5MPiyGimlIGJ1IOsa8Dy5Rfc4ZhgEA8Kfy-v8Wz8iS8afvdbq2ICvLl6s_OKUGdhdzYYUbHJmobJorBpTw7sUOPKv6pxrKUFDyYpnjTBL_7fuBqE-MnbtpyTivrTzgrmRtlyRbUIWu3ruERfrQBUHt5dtbkkcbnDxFaSJeijFIhoq4Gb0k_7tK8tYC2JnqzffUwWbL3uE=&c=-lYH7I5pX9HzvaaF1XBCN5INordA44OYYV9TAfxA2WzwLq6XORUSLA==&ch=K0kvSQlv1HnWiJriLpQXoxdAZ4XRwb5sTgWCBORjBVLEsPCsPBVadA==).
I cannot imagine what the Robb Elementary School and Ulvade, TX community are feeling. PLEASE PRAY FOR THEIR FAMILIES and may God have mercy on us.

I hope you and your family have a good Memorial Day weekend. Never forget freedom isn't free and never forget the many men and women have given there all for us.

| General Assembly
---
|
---
| We have much work ahead of us to make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family. It is an honor to be your voice and to fight for our conservative values in Richmond. Inflation, rising gas prices, baby formula shortage, taxes, public safety, education, school choice, Ukraine, election integrity, infrastructure, rural broadband, healthcare, protecting the sanctity of life, protecting our Second Amendment, and more are on the minds of fellow Virginians. We must get people back to work. Governor Youngkin and the rest of us in the General Assembly are working diligently to address your concerns.
The increased cost of living is probably the #1 concern for fellow Virginians. The following March inflation numbers continue to climb: Overall CPI was up 8.5%, gas is close to 5 dollars, electricity is up 11.1%, meat poultry and fish are up 13.8%, milk is up 13.3% coffee is up 11.2%, used car prices up 35.3% and airline fares are up 23.6%.
---
| Special Session/ Budget
---
| We are still in special session and without a budget, and we still have bills in conference. Establishing the budget would have been done if we had a Republican State Senate, as most agree that we need: tax relief, raises for teachers, more money for schools, and law enforcement. Democrats in the Senate are dragging things out and trying to block Governor Youngkin's agenda.
Governor Glenn Youngkin's goal with the Virginia's budget is to designate $5 billion to provide cost-reducing, economy-growing tax relief directly to Virginians, and to use the remaining $9 billion to invest in making Virginia best-in-class. Local governments need a completed budget ASAP to continue to function. [Click here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013L-Ad9ZM8gSNPUCuj-Mwv_bfh2o-ZAJprenhNzfPF2u4Yv0SAt-_KqsSavLHWt-okBvtPLswJB_jbv3zrw-AV3Zp33W6JFHO4gfDIjYHHrBj-bJDWzh4Pvp63Eh0LWPC2FB3Yhe3FdapbNW0J4SSZtnyUAk-k28Bdi96NMsYA8PMG-oqQzDobpu836mcfkJo6kNPymqjodfwc95lKnWU4UinBdiMLZX--ZsVCsZMuFw=&c=-lYH7I5pX9HzvaaF1XBCN5INordA44OYYV9TAfxA2WzwLq6XORUSLA==&ch=K0kvSQlv1HnWiJriLpQXoxdAZ4XRwb5sTgWCBORjBVLEsPCsPBVadA==) for a story on the proposed budget to include a 4 billion dollar compromise, grocery Tax, Veteran retirement tax, and more.
FYI Governor Youngkin signed the 45 day limitation on emergency executive orders putting an end to the Governor Northam style 2 year emergency shut downs. HB 158 [Click here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013L-Ad9ZM8gSNPUCuj-Mwv_bfh2o-ZAJprenhNzfPF2u4Yv0SAt-_KqsSavLHWt-o--k-DNLrydHl8TKuKG6_dFaNAo01Qnt00w4pjKyhEZy9bPE0rTAN_tmL9bnlctgg7n85-GzO_IYHi-QcId2Km_KZCFh1FqoWDsL9-bw0J5q_q3hEQOhXAXEmB2VgqOYO4oEyVSDoRqzBxVELMJlDaJVQd4yI5GNn&c=-lYH7I5pX9HzvaaF1XBCN5INordA44OYYV9TAfxA2WzwLq6XORUSLA==&ch=K0kvSQlv1HnWiJriLpQXoxdAZ4XRwb5sTgWCBORjBVLEsPCsPBVadA==)
We are being told the Hyde Amendment, a legislative provision barring the use of federal funds to pay for abortion, except to save the life of the woman, or if the pregnancy arises from incest or rape, will be in the budget. I will keep you posted!
We are all proud to serve with Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin. We hope to complete the budget next Wednesday. Here is my April update, with some of the things on my mind, and what I've been up to around the district:
---
| Education Report
---
|
---
| The report Governor Youngkin ordered on his first day in office is in, and the results aren't pretty. Said simply, Virginia has maintained an illusion of student achievement by easing standards and moving the goal posts on what constitutes adequate learning. The end result is that kids are being left behind, even while their parents think they're getting a solid education. We all knew we were in trouble when they wanted to get rid of advanced diplomas and called advanced classes racist. The good news is we passed a required parent consent bill for sexually explicit material. I'm running for state Senate so we can un- California Virginia and create the best education environment for students to achieve!

| It is an honor to have staunch conservative and fellow Veteran Senator Dick Black on my team for State Senate and his endorsement. Together we will un-California Virginia!

Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner) | Please Pray | | Our children are #1. There is no doubt America is experiencing a spiritual crises. Those who ridicule us for saying thoughts and prayers tells us much. The massacre that left 19 children and two adults dead in Texas is EXTREMELY heartbreaking. To succeed as a country we must be a moral nation. Evil does exist and we must be vigilant. Let's keep an eye on each other. If you see something, say something, and do something. The breakdown of the family, homes without a father, removal of prayer from school, and politicians who have declared war on our police have caused many of the problems we are experiencing. Next year I will again introduce my SRO (armed officer) requirement in every school bill (dems voted no) and will look into including a price cap for private schools to equal or not exceed what public schools pay, and more. Guns do not kill people, people kill people. England banned guns years ago yet London's murder rate exceeded New York in 2018 so the mayor banned knives ==. I cannot imagine what the Robb Elementary School and Ulvade, TX community are feeling. PLEASE PRAY FOR THEIR FAMILIES and may God have mercy on us. | Memorial Day Weekend | | We would not have a country without our military. On Memorial Day we honor and remember U.S. military personnel who have died while serving in the United States armed forces. I hope you and your family have a good Memorial Day weekend. Never forget freedom isn't free and never forget the many men and women have given there all for us. | Congressman Good | | Congratulations Bob Good on winning the nomination at the 5th Congressional District Convention. I had a great time meeting fellow conservatives from all over the district. | McGuire & Brat Endorse Yesli Vega for Congress VA 7 | | | Yesli Vega Meet & Greet | == | I am happy to see Congressman Dave Brat join me in endorsing our friend Yesli Vega for the 7th Congressional District. Please join me June 2nd 6PM to 8 PM at crossroads Baptist Church located at 4236 Lee Hill School Dr., Fredericksburg, VA 22408 for a meet and greet with our next Congresswoman Yesli Vega! == to RSVP | General Assembly | | We have much work ahead of us to make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family. It is an honor to be your voice and to fight for our conservative values in Richmond. Inflation, rising gas prices, baby formula shortage, taxes, public safety, education, school choice, Ukraine, election integrity, infrastructure, rural broadband, healthcare, protecting the sanctity of life, protecting our Second Amendment, and more are on the minds of fellow Virginians. We must get people back to work. Governor Youngkin and the rest of us in the General Assembly are working diligently to address your concerns. The increased cost of living is probably the #1 concern for fellow Virginians. The following March inflation numbers continue to climb: Overall CPI was up 8.5%, gas is close to 5 dollars, electricity is up 11.1%, meat poultry and fish are up 13.8%, milk is up 13.3% coffee is up 11.2%, used car prices up 35.3% and airline fares are up 23.6%. | Special Session/ Budget | We are still in special session and without a budget, and we still have bills in conference. Establishing the budget would have been done if we had a Republican State Senate, as most agree that we need: tax relief, raises for teachers, more money for schools, and law enforcement. Democrats in the Senate are dragging things out and trying to block Governor Youngkin's agenda. Governor Glenn Youngkin's goal with the Virginia's budget is to designate $5 billion to provide cost-reducing, economy-growing tax relief directly to Virginians, and to use the remaining $9 billion to invest in making Virginia best-in-class. Local governments need a completed budget ASAP to continue to function. == for a story on the proposed budget to include a 4 billion dollar compromise, grocery Tax, Veteran retirement tax, and more. FYI Governor Youngkin signed the 45 day limitation on emergency executive orders putting an end to the Governor Northam style 2 year emergency shut downs. HB 158 == We are being told the Hyde Amendment, a legislative provision barring the use of federal funds to pay for abortion, except to save the life of the woman, or if the pregnancy arises from incest or rape, will be in the budget. I will keep you posted! We are all proud to serve with Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin. We hope to complete the budget next Wednesday. Here is my April update, with some of the things on my mind, and what I've been up to around the district: | Education Report | | The report Governor Youngkin ordered on his first day in office is in, and the results aren't pretty. Said simply, Virginia has maintained an illusion of student achievement by easing standards and moving the goal posts on what constitutes adequate learning. The end result is that kids are being left behind, even while their parents think they're getting a solid education. We all knew we were in trouble when they wanted to get rid of advanced diplomas and called advanced classes racist. The good news is we passed a required parent consent bill for sexually explicit material. I'm running for state Senate so we can un- California Virginia and create the best education environment for students to achieve! | State Senator & Fellow Veteran Dick Black | | It is an honor to have staunch conservative and fellow Veteran Senator Dick Black on my team for State Senate and his endorsement. Together we will un-California Virginia! | Delegate Mike Cherry Fundraiser | | I attended the 26th Annual Legislative Breakfast fundraiser at the Keystone Antique Truck & Tractor Museum for our friend Delegate Mike Cherry! Governor Glenn Youngkin and Speaker Todd Gilbert spoke on session, progress made, and work to be done. Fellow Delegates Roxanne Robinson and Carry Coyner were there as well! | Roe vs Wade | == | News for those of us that are 100 % pro-life: According to a leaked draft majority opinion, the Supreme Court has voted to strike down the Roe v. Wade decision. If true, this is a huge victory for the sanctity of life. This unprecedented leak is dangerous to our democracy as it was most likely leaked to cause protests, impact elections, and attempt to change the SCOTUS opinion. == for the story. | Mr. Speaker | | It has been an honor working with our Virginia Republican Speaker Todd Gilbert and the rest of our caucus. We are working hard to improve Virginia!. | National Day of Prayer | | Each year I have the honor of giving praise to our Lord and Savior with some amazing people in Louisa County on the National Day of Prayer. | Hanover Sheriff's Office Foundation 2022 Golf Tournament | | Hanover County Sheriff's Office Foundation 2022 Charity Golf Tournament. It was great to see Hanover Sherrif David Hines, deputies, other elected officials and sponsors there to support a good cause. Participants played a competitive round of golf while building funds to serve those members of the Sheriff's Office who may need assistance in the event of illness or injury! #backyheblue #virginia #thankyou | Congratulations to The Family Foundation Action | == | Congratulations to The Family Foundation Action for winning your huge case against the Loudoun County School Board! == | My Brothers in the News | == | The US Navy SEALs are developing new ways to prepare for near-peer warfare against China or Russia. == | Goochland Day Parade | | | | | Double thumbs up for the May 7 Goochland Day Parade. | | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zvl6d1v1eollnvgi2jm5sgvu59ifesgj6ebpi7no_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctgm4o76cph2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That 's why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zf0k3nsgediu71h688il5blo6cl5clora4tahku0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6ctgm4o76cph2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Fellow American, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Fellow American, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNj8tqxDAMRb8m2SXEj2TsRRaFkt10UQpdGlmWZ0wTJ9jOlP59Pf2CghYXCXTPcbNDBwzbMPOB82Hkig1SCdYDgZKaC5QXJQZPjRxgpVT6RMdp14AQC-QvvyekHvetvc8ITg9aa6ARNU1CSS-09GqUI7PMXtrPq7lCWEO8vcFGcyrepGyADDywyyGGTN1Gm4MfM3ZcdZwb1q7zvZQjN-Kl4UudTHgm6iGS28uzue7qt_Qk6h5UKEHMHVKsqZ7QOuutAO05Mc_1qJWwjVjyflZyg7ujRry-fyzVfGJtmt3xHdY15OlSlW9b5f3TK__D_QXjGm3e)

When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation’s heroes deserve.**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNj8tqxDAMRb8m2SXEj2TsRRaFkt10UQpdGlmWZ0wTJ9jOlP59Pf2CghYXCXTPcbNDBwzbMPOB82Hkig1SCdYDgZKaC5QXJQZPjRxgpVT6RMdp14AQC-QvvyekHvetvc8ITg9aa6ARNU1CSS-09GqUI7PMXtrPq7lCWEO8vcFGcyrepGyADDywyyGGTN1Gm4MfM3ZcdZwb1q7zvZQjN-Kl4UudTHgm6iGS28uzue7qt_Qk6h5UKEHMHVKsqZ7QOuutAO05Mc_1qJWwjVjyflZyg7ujRry-fyzVfGJtmt3xHdY15OlSlW9b5f3TK__D_QXjGm3e)

The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump. This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is more important now than ever — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home. The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam. * Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. | Erik Aadland cordially invites you to meet for conversation and comradery in Arvada on June 1st at 5:30PM
This is a great opportunity for you to get to know the frontrunner for the Republican nomination for U.S. House of Representatives. Bring your questions and issues to talk one-on-one with Erik Aadland.
The primary election is coming, so let Erik help you decide how to cast your vote!

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---

| |

| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

Hello —

As I watched Rick Caruso try to buy the mayoral election, I did a lot of soul searching. How could I do what's best for our city? **Last week I stepped aside to endorse my longtime friend, colleague, and partner Karen Bass for Mayor of Los Angeles.**

I'm proud of the campaign I ran for Los Angeles Mayor, and I'm deeply grateful for all the encouragement I've received along the way. But this is bigger than any one candidate.

Rick Caruso has spent an astonishing amount of money — $30 million and counting— to buy this race. His campaign is a toxic mix of false claims, promises he can't keep, and desperate efforts to distance himself from his record of supporting right-wing politicians who do **not** share L.A.'s values.

Karen can — and _must_ — win because the stakes for Los Angeles could hardly be higher. I am doing all I can to support her in this final stretch before primary election day, and that's why I'm asking for your help:
