subject: Cheney spends more time fist-bumping Biden & praising Pelosi than she does fighting the Left
body:
this will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Dear Peter,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
[DONATE NOW](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, l**et me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party. . . and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was dupped by these same "Republicans." **

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
[DONATE NOW](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
[DONATE NOW](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
[DONATE NOW](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479204:J66CbnoNC:m:1:3317145305:208989DC5E6521264C1278F848542944:r)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S.: It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats. If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney. I'm getting ahead of myself. Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help. My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home. Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age. They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party. . . and sold out our country to the highest bidder. I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was dupped by these same "Republicans." And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values. Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office. And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me! As I said at the start of this email, President Trump is 100% behind me. He knows the people of Wyoming - and the American people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress. In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government. In Washington, I promise to do the same... ...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who waste our tax dollars , fling open our borders , and silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives who disagree! But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours. You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election. In fact, when liberal 60 Minutes asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country." Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden. Again, I'll need your help to beat her. As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment. That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good. But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good. Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against. Will you help me make sure we win that fight? Respectfully, Harriet Hageman America First Conservative for Congress (WY) P.S.: It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress. name: Gary Sinise
subject: Most don't know this about Memorial Day
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile,_ but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I'm honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they're bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our "Greatest Generation" heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ as this year's event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation's heroes deserve.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r) But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.

On Memorial Day "this year and every year" please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more._ Peter, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please a€" [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479548:63VPbnoNj:m:1:3253819041:9E6FC0A331CBC399468A2871E2E0803E:r)
---
Sincerely,

Gary Sinise
Honorary Grand Marshal
National Memorial Day Parade

clean_body: I’m ready to be the leader our state needs in Washington D.C. | | Hello my fabulous friends! I know my team has been emailing you all week, but I really wanted to catch you before you log off for Memorial Day and thank you for all of your hard work this month. We’ve made some pretty big asks of you over the last few weeks, and whether we’ve needed a few extra canvassers, more voters to show out at the polls, or a last-minute fundraising boost, you’ve had my back each and every step of the way. Friend, from the bottom of my heart, I hope you know how much it means to me to have your trust in this fight to bring progress back to Nebraska. The day I first set foot in the Nebraska Legislature, I made a promise to my community, to my district, and to each of you that I would fight with everything I have to give our neighbors a representative they could count on. And I have gone to work every day since with the intention of making good on my promise. This Special Election, we have the opportunity to set our state on a new path to progress and elect a congresswoman who will put Nebraskans — not dark money or partisan agendas — first. I am ready to be the leader our state needs in Washington D.C., but friend, if we don’t hit our end-of-month fundraising goal, this critical moment could pass us by. = Thank you again, friend. _\----- Original Message from Mondaire Jones May 21, 2022 -----_
Hey, thanks for opening this email. I want to give you an important update on the redistricting process here in New York. You may have heard some news about our re-election campaign, and I want you to hear directly from me about my decision.
The final congressional map released last night is the result of partisan politics – drawn by an out-of-state, Republican court appointee who has shown utter disregard for cultural, social, and economic communities of interest. Ultimately, it was designed to reduce the number of New York Democrats in Congress.
To help secure our Democratic House majority, I have decided to avoid a brutal primary with another sitting member of Congress and run for another term in Congress in NY-10, an open seat in a newly created district.
NY-10 is the birthplace of the LGBTQ+ rights movement. Since long before the Stonewall Uprising, queer people of color have sought refuge within its borders.
I’m excited to make my case for why I’m the right person to lead this district forward and to continue my work in Congress to save our democracy from the threats of the far right.
In my first term, I have worked hard to deliver real results for New York State. I helped pass the American Rescue Plan and critical investments in infrastructure for New Yorkers. I have also worked to increase affordable housing and have led the fight to protect the rights of women and LGBTQ+ individuals. With our democracy under threat from the far right, I co-authored and helped the House pass the _Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act_ and introduced the _Judiciary Act_ to expand the Supreme Court.
I look forward to being a champion for NY-10 in Congress.
I’ll be honest — this new path is going to be difficult, but not impossible. A new congressional map means new challenges that are going to require us to fight harder to reach voters and overcome negative attacks from opponents.
But it also means a new opportunity to continue leading as a progressive champion in Congress. And now that it’s official, we can finally start the process of planning our organizing efforts in NY-10 and start engaging new supporters and volunteers.
**[The work ahead is going to be tough — but we know it will be rewarding. name: Gary Sinise
subject: Every American should be proud
body:
| | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile,_ but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I'm honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they're bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our "Greatest Generation" heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ as this year's event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation's heroes deserve.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r) But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.

On Memorial Day "this year and every year" please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more._ Peter, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please a€" [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)
---
Sincerely,

Gary Sinise
Honorary Grand Marshal
National Memorial Day Parade

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479696:J_1H2noN7:m:1:3317145305:7AFA729F6799ACFC0DCCD44977C5901F:r)

Dear fellow American,

Did you know there is a specific legislative provision ensuring that your federal tax dollars do not fund abortions?

Since 1976, the Hyde Amendment has protected American taxpayers from paying for abortions. Throughout its history, the Hyde Amendment has received widespread bipartisan support from both Congress and the White House. But if President Biden, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.), Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.), and their pro-abortion allies in Congress have their way, this critically important provision could be undone.

[**Please, right now, sign this No Taxpayer Funding of Abortion emergency petition to House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIxNDgtYmRjYjc1ZmQ5ZTRiNDhmMTk3NGM1NzI5ZmJmYjRkMmMiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHA6Ly93d3cuZnJjYWN0aW9uLm9yZy9kLTIyMDVfNCJ9/66NZd7QqjSvF68QP3HnDFA)

The pro-abortion lobby is hard at work trying to roll back the Hyde Amendment, as well as the many pro-life victories achieved during the Trump administration, including:
* The Protecting Life in Global Health Assistance (PLGHA) policy, which blocked funding for international organizations that perform or promote abortion;
* A Title X rule change that closed an abortion funding loophole by ensuring financial and physical separation between family planning clinics and abortion facilities;
* An executive order that reinforced existing protections for children born prematurely, with disabilities, or in medical distress, including infants who survive abortion; and
* A conscience exemption from the Obamacare "contraceptive mandate" for organizations with moral or religious objections to purchasing insurance that includes coverage of contraceptives and abortion-causing drugs.

According to a January 2021 Marist poll, 58% of Americans oppose taxpayer funding of abortion. But unless you and I - and many thousands of other Americans who value life - speak up now, the Pelosi-led House and Schumer-led Senate are very likely to ignore the will of the people and act against our values and the lives of the unborn.

[**You and I must take a stand NOW to preserve pro-life policy and ensure the Hyde Amendment remains intact for future generations.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIxNDgtYmRjYjc1ZmQ5ZTRiNDhmMTk3NGM1NzI5ZmJmYjRkMmMiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMyIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHA6Ly93d3cuZnJjYWN0aW9uLm9yZy9kLTIyMDVfNCJ9/xnO0F2-IoNA69n-EU5uZnw)

President Biden's new proposed federal budget removed the Hyde Amendment-following through on a campaign promise made by every Democratic presidential candidate in 2020. We must act now to demand that our tax dollars NOT fund abortions.

Family Research Council Action has been working feverishly to defeat the pro-abortion special interests and their allies in Congress.

We've been working with pro-life legislators in Congress to help secure the passage of important legislation, and we've been working at the state level all across America to protect life as well.

With New York passing one of the most radical pro-abortion laws in our nation's history, the Democrat governor in Virginia discussing letting unwanted born-alive babies die, and Democrats controlling Congress, innocent unborn lives are at risk in America like never before.

If you and I remain silent, innocent children will tragically die.

[**Please help us fight back against President Joe Biden, Speaker Nancy Pelosi, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, and their pro-abortion allies today.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.net/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzMDk2NTg1IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIxNDgtYmRjYjc1ZmQ5ZTRiNDhmMTk3NGM1NzI5ZmJmYjRkMmMiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiNCIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHA6Ly93d3cuZnJjYWN0aW9uLm9yZy9kLTIyMDVfNCJ9/yU6Oi0A-V5E31ljGJDXu9w)

That's why, ahead of our May end-of-month fundraising deadline, it's so important that you make your first contribution of $5 or whatever you can spare to defeat Sen. Grassley. The best link to donate is right here: = I am not someone who backs down from a challenge, and I've gone up against people like Sen. Grassley before: I won an election against a man double my age, flipped a House seat blue and became the youngest woman to pass legislation through the House. Still, as a young woman in public service, I can't count the number of times I've been underestimated or counted out. The pundits and so-called experts will say what they want to say, but at the end of the day, I know that with lots of hard work and unwavering grassroots support, we will flip this Senate seat blue. This is personal. Right now, working families in communities across Iowa are being failed by a senator who has left them behind. Those families are my family. Dad was a union pipefitter-welder, and Mom worked for the Dubuque public school system. They inspired me to show up for my community, which is exactly why I'm running to defeat Sen. Grassley. It's time to lift up the voices of Iowa's working families in the Senate. Peter, I appreciate you sticking with me as I write about what this race means to me. I'm going to bring this email to a close, but before I do, I've got to press the importance of building up a grassroots movement again. subject: Drain the swamp in Mississippi – update from our state’s free market think tank
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/jxncrime-8132432?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear Friend,

**How often do we hear the phrase ‘drain the swamp’? **

It’s a phrase bandied about by politicians seeking to signal that they are on our side. Washington, we are told, is a place full of federal bureaucrats making public policy with little reference to the public.

But what about ‘the swamp’ closer to home?

Before complaining about the federal fat cat agencies in Washington, we ought to acknowledge that there are plenty of self-serving bureaucrats right there in Mississippi.

**Our new report shows that Mississippi’s bureaucrats are out of control.** Of the 222 agencies and boards that we reviewed, only a tiny minority are headed by a directly elected official. Of those that are appointed, the state Senate confirms only a small minority.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=72f87e4e56&e=5703353baa)
---
| The administrative state in Mississippi gets to make public policy and spend public money with too little accountability to the public.

Of course, there are plenty of departments and boards that are essential to effective public administration. But Mississippi has dozens of agencies and boards that we could probably do without. I have no doubt that plenty of good people work for the Auctioneer Commission or the Board of Physical Therapists. But other states seem to cope without such entities. Might Mississippi be able to manage without an Interior Design Advisory Committee?

When Ronald Reagan launched his presidential campaign at the Neshoba County Fair in 1980, he famously observed how “ _When you create a government bureaucracy, no matter how well-intentioned it is, almost instantly its primary priority becomes the preservation of the bureaucracy."_ The Gipper was absolutely right back then, and the problem has grown much worse since.

**Too many boards and commissions in our state have far too much power to decide public policy.** Often this is the fault of the legislature that has delegated to these agencies' broad powers. But it is also, as Reagan understood, in the nature of bureaucracy to expand unless it is kept in check.

Our report makes a number of suggestions to make Mississippi’s public officials better accountable to the public:
* Rein in the wide discretion that the legislature has foolishly granted officials.
* Sunset provisions to ensure that bureaucracy does not continue to expand long after it has served its initial purpose.
* More legislative oversight of the bureaucracy and how it spends public money.
* Eliminating certain agencies altogether.

**Many of these agencies and commissions have become a source of patronage. They are run in the interests of vested interests. **Instead of economic freedom, they have spawned a cartel economic system in our state, in which someone’s permission is always needed to do something.

Key to achieving economic prosperity in Mississippi is to overturn this cartel economic system and eliminate our home-grown version of the administrative state. Our report shows how.

Have a wonderful Memorial Day weekend!

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

Friend,
Bad news. This summer, you’ll likely see a higher electric bill.
And if you live in Mississippi, the burden could be even greater.
Booming natural gas prices, hot temperatures, and the lowest median household income in the nation all converge, making the Magnolia State one of the least energy-efficient states in the country.
We have lots of room for improvement — starting by ousting Congressman Guest.
Instead of developing policies that would diversify energy sources and offer relief for low-income folks, Michael Guest clings to his Big Oil friends.
❌ He’s repeatedly struck down legislation that would build strategic reserves.
❌ He’s unanimously opposed investments in renewable energy, which would foster training and job opportunities in our region and increase wages.
❌ He’s voted down legislation that would expand Medicaid and drive down insulin prices — so fewer people would have to decide between paying for meds and keeping the lights on.
✅ But he’s supported $440 billion in subsidies for oil companies.
Unlike Congressman Guest, I’m not taking a dime from oil companies. We need to get our state energy efficient, end of discussion. My campaign is supported by regular, hardworking people ready to see results in Washington D.C.

body:
Hey friend!

Is it just me or is campaign season absolutely flying by? In a few days it'll be June, and that means the summer campaign season is about to get underway.

Personally, it's my favorite part of this whole process. From knocking on doors and marching in parades, to having conversations with voters all across the state. The weather is warm and you can really feel the excitement beginning to build. Election Day will be here before we know it.

Of course, behind the scenes, our campaign finance operation is setting a strong pace designed to get us to Election Day. Our average donation this month ticked down slightly to a nice round $21, and while you might think we get worried about that sort of thing, it actually confirms my favorite aspect of our grassroots support network: this campaign is built on small donations from voters who care about our democracy and will do anything to protect it.

So, friend, as we wind up the month of May I have a small ask. Chip in our average monthly donation of $21. It will go a long way towards supporting Jocelyn’s re-election campaign in November.

Donate>> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=052822&amount=21]

-Emily

Peter,

Since day one in Congress, Derek has been leading the effort to reduce the role of money in politics, fix the broken political system, and get Congress back on track and working for the people. subject: I'm Liz Cheney's primary challenger
body:
this will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Dear Peter,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, l**et me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party. . . and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was dupped by these same "Republicans." **

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S.: It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more - will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479003:JazKvnoNA:m:1:3253819041:03212A80A1481309112711E9BA243AD0:r)

| | Dear Fellow American,
A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life.
In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.”
Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism.
Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country.
**Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=de6dd12c73934ddca11af23dc38930c7&_e=HqnVaM88ZLTuuioDYl4VPoRC6R6TmmxzeY3k3OZQZ4SMmEbpAGa-Ggib4pjHa7EDRMprgyzPSvTxTC7B-ZstC2S4h1SQfTmEIVgl5qbJtnSr3pDDT4nuEvkjbUp6oXNNLPQ5z-uZrFTBR0efbey1AavJQS8qbsNGwPFEti-hcvlrVcDLn--MhgYtKIUPH0RL59_BTmrziQmzL387HjK4gRjy7PPiXFI3X1r4ZEk-dsuxWrl7HlfpPBMZSNSV3s9rsgGOv2ui88YYUrrgiSQwFsu3-k_O6n1ssfLlV38B65NYvjQqubxsAXmrKF-Jeqwb9kEbYMQ8E-Jj7My8LylGnZjgZgS_VoFQHrZo6Uet_cgAhYAwN9vUMdLmAfnG0PwMQUEyYZdSGl1tQCetomSEcfCT76wgKAvsSFY7auNW1jT3PjU-jZlQmC3eArqw4lbxleEl3w78264aq00CJY9qFBiR8jx6NwqzrhQACa1VvIc%3D)**
Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that...
**. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. **
**Why is this?**
Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists.
At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried.
This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media.
Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military.
But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous.
You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020.
In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed.
**That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. **
By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.
We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country.
Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical.
As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.”
If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today.
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=de6dd12c73934ddca11af23dc38930c7&_e=HqnVaM88ZLTuuioDYl4VPoRC6R6TmmxzeY3k3OZQZ4SMmEbpAGa-Ggib4pjHa7EDRMprgyzPSvTxTC7B-ZstC2S4h1SQfTmEIVgl5qbJtnSr3pDDT4nuEvkjbUp6oXNNLPQ5z-uZrFTBR0efbey1AavJQS8qbsNGwPFEti-hcvlrVcDLn--MhgYtKIUPH0RL59_BTmrziQmzL387HjK4gRjy7PPiXFI3X1r4ZEk-dsuxWrl7HlfpPBMZSNSV3s9rsgGOv2ui88YYUrrgiSQwFot2eKJzGqgln3DfOwj7Q_zhZ5S-n0imqnkWnXeLhaBo3Ekuif7kHYE4V89g8cKnga-z6n_mu73zwC8dNU0hy-sKakEg2zOBGddOJBQZbbwtxWXsmG-IdvUnqKoiixs1gjYi4nxG10seoXRVVsio3H-2_scSRuwh0YZCkiO4GbA62qVeaB7P0Puk3zHUUZKUcqN1Hr1Q-cecCrn0_GldVW0%3D)**
Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Hi there,

I'm Helene, Kirsten's daughter. I know it's been a rough few weeks for us all.

Whenever I'm feeling scared or unsure about something, I talk to my mom. She's been there for me my whole life and has _always_ been able to offer me comfort any time I'm feeling down. And I don’t have to tell you, there’s a lot that’s getting me down lately.

But rather than letting things get _her_ down, mom’s going in a different direction.

She’s channeling the anger and the frustration that we’re all feeling right now, and using it to fuel her as this campaign heats up. The things that are the most upsetting, or the scariest, are her biggest motivators.

**The very real possibility I’m going to grow up with fewer rights than her is deeply disturbing.

The fact that the gun violence tearing apart our communities isn't enough to stir Republicans into action disappoints and angers her.**

But these things are only reminding her of why she’s running in the first place. She wants to keep me and kids like me safe in our schools. She wants to keep abortion safe and legal for my generation and the generations to come.

So as my mom is showing me, there’s no time to sit around being depressed. There’s only time to act. It would be so easy for me, for my mom, and frankly all of us to be discouraged by what’s happening. Instead, mom looks like she’s ready to run through a brick wall. She is fired up and ready to go. And I gotta tell you, it’s pretty cool to see. I’m really proud of her and I hope you are, too.

And because I'm still too young to vote, I’m helping in other ways. Forgive my bluntness, but I need to cut right to the chase: We still haven't raised the $10,000 we need to hit our end-of-month fundraising goal, and I'm counting on your donation to get us back on track.
As one of this team's most engaged grassroots supporters, you know the stakes better than most, but it bears repeating: Donald Trump, Mitch McConnell, and the entire Republican establishment are determined to flip a Democratic Senate seat - perhaps even this one - to take back control of the chamber.
Shifting political grounds here in Connecticut make this year particularly unpredictable: Recently, RNC Chairwoman and noted Trump apologist Ronna McDaniel helped christen a new national Republican campaign office in this state - the national GOP's first ever office here. I won't parse words: **They are making this state, and this Senate seat, a target.**
And do you know what they count on after making our seat a target? They count on us missing these fundraising goals. They count on us being under-resourced. They count on weakness. That's why we cannot let extremist Republicans think - even for a moment - that we don't have what it takes to win this race.
**Friend, at this critical moment for our nation, I 'm counting on you to help me show the strength of this campaign. So please, will you chip in a donation now to prove to Trump, McConnell, and the rest of the GOP that this Senate seat - and the Senate as a whole - will stay in Democratic control?**

subject: A very difficult decision
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
It's these kinds of decisions in the early stages that make a huge difference down the road.
#

Hey team — it’s Ana, Alessandra’s Campaign Manager.
I had to make a very difficult decision yesterday after our Friday budget meeting.
Since we launched our campaign on Tuesday, it’s become clear that in order to keep growing our coalition of supporters across the progressive movement and win, we already need to scale up our investments in digital advertising and organizing.
**The money wasn’t in our May budget — but I gave the green light anyway.**

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Keeping up the fight for a *living* minimum wage in this country
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
If this ballot measure is successful, it will be a model for the rest of the nation and prove there is real momentum behind a fair minimum wage.
#
$7.25/hour is $15,000 per year. That’s far from a living wage, Peter.
While I’m still working hard to raise the wage in Congress, **we have a real chance to make it happen in Michigan through a question on the general election ballot this November.**
If this ballot measure is successful, it will be a model for the rest of the nation and prove there is real momentum behind a fair minimum wage. But One Fair Wage must gather 340,000 valid signatures by June 1 — leaving them with just 4 days to make it happen.
So today, I'm asking: [**Will you split a $3 contribution between One Fair Wage Action and my campaign to help us keep up the fight for a fair minimum wage in this country?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13906?t=1&akid=1303%2E420207%2ED4l-3R)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13906?t=20&akid=1303%2E420207%2ED4l-3R)**
The ballot question that One Fair Wage is fighting for in Michigan would raise the minimum wage in the state to $15 per hour by 2027, index the minimum wage to inflation, and eliminate the subminimum wage for tipped workers.
**That’s just good policy — and I know from personal experience.** I helped make Seattle the first major city in the country to pass a $15/hour minimum wage. Working families and the local economy thrived. The city was even named the best place for business and careers, easily _dispelling the corporate-backed myth that businesses would fail._
We can't wait any longer if we're going to heal the wounds of this devastating pandemic and help working families stay afloat in this time of economic uncertainty. **Raising the wage will alleviate the economic pressures communities face, give 27 million workers a raise, and lift nearly one million Americans out of poverty.**
[**As Michigan goes, so goes the nation. Split a $3 contribution between One Fair Wage and my campaign today, so we have the resources to deliver a full and fair minimum wage to working families all across the country.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13906?t=21&akid=1303%2E420207%2ED4l-3R)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13906?t=22&akid=1303%2E420207%2ED4l-3R)**
Twenty states just raised their minimum wage going into 2021 — including Florida, while voting for Donald Trump. Don’t let anyone tell you this policy is unpopular. _We will win._
In solidarity,
Pramila

| Dear Peter,

As a follow-up to Abigail's longer email about gun violence prevention legislation and advocacy, I wanted to send along her interview with Lawrence O'Donnell about her experiences as a former federal agent and the policies she is advocating for.
---
| [WATCH ](https://act.myngp.com/el/zZi0PZqrd2KOthNRBkQ8VrpMgCeEcpdlO1kIYHshFHk=/fSmzwIK7xXL5wD_CzUG6_APG_LIouLO3nscYs4T_xP0=?v=3gRzDgQqF9E)
---
Thank you,
Sam
* * *
Peter,

I write with a deep sadness but renewed resolve, and I hope you will take the time to read this email and commit [or recommit] to advocating for change. Year after year and shooting after shooting, there are always calls to "not get political" as we mourn our fellow Americans.

But everything is political, including how we keep our kids safe in school, because the policies and laws that govern our communities, states, and country are decided by the people we elect. And as community member after community member reaches out to me desperately asking what can be done, **let me tell you about some of the straightforward policies I support and why.**

**Raise the age to purchase assault-style weapons:** Per federal law, you must be 21 to purchase a handgun, you can buy an assault-style weapon like an AR-15 at 18. We must raise the age to 21.

**Reinstate a ban on large-capacity magazines: **The data clearly show that large-capacity magazines make shootings significantly more lethal because murderers can shoot more rounds faster.

**Put Extreme Risk Protective Order (ERPO) legislation in place:** Ensure that law enforcement can take action when they receive reports from family or friends that someone might be a harm to themselves or others.

**Require Background Checks on all sales:** Per federal law, some people with a history of violence are prohibited from purchasing firearms. To ensure these "prohibited buyers" can't buy a firearm, would-be purchasers must fill out a background check form. However, federal law only requires a background check at federally-licensed points of sale, which means in many states, online sales or gun show sales do not require a background check!

The House of Representatives has twice voted to ensure the law is enforced across all points of sale with **H.R. 8, the Bipartisan Background Checks Act.** The legislation passed the House with the support of eight Republicans who value this common-sense law. It awaits a vote in the Senate.

**Close the Charleston Loophole: **Per federal law, gun purchases may occur by default after three business days -- even if a background check has not been returned. Though 90% of federal background checks are completed in minutes, the ones that take longer are four times more likely to be denied, and this means the three-day default results in guns being sold to prohibited buyers, including the man who murdered congregants of Emanuel AME Church in Charleston, SC. **H.R. 1446 Enhanced Background Checks Act of 2021** would lengthen the default period from three days to 10. This bill passed the House with bipartisan support and awaits a vote in the Senate.

**If you want to learn more about these issues or get engaged in local advocacy,** take a look at the following organizations. They have local chapters and whether you're a parent, a gun owner, a student, or simply concerned about this issue, there is a place for you!

Peter, The days after the Uvalde elementary school shooting have been heavy and infuriating. There’s no excuse for why mass shootings like the one in Uvalde keep occuring on such a routine basis. But we’re not going to let this become normalized, we’re not going to become numb to this, and we’re not going to let elected officials like Kyrsten Sinema sit by and watch while human lives are lost. Here’s 4 action items you can do right now to help make a difference:
1. [**_Donate directly to victims’ families through this VictimsFirst organized fund._**](https://an.primarysinema.com/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDK7b6Fqbor3bYFGUJCwWOAoNhCWWERZZsKewyc-sPNx8Muf53E-YnUbO75OIdRNzDgoSbUWPg2YRewnK0NgIVm4bTb6xUBHhxAtp-JU3BpjB-zp9YdsWGJYhCLcszFNPjLPliu6v6C4ru5MJPOxEf64ChjfX6CW3aO4rcrBrIY0Nd4pfxwKJEwy3Ic_J4xIymjeO7QkkXPOpNwOta2SFaEjKZuUeNDdte1ZXs6QgE1t1AFMnLjQkISAoHilKRiRcT6rkX-61htoQw3jN7bt69xlrW8-j56JEJOnjcD8dxM9vaqqUG51A2BpB58VnJrHR2PhfQH88UAVr_Q78cum4XEo/3mf/LJ93xufdR3-L0A4KBjXg8g/h1/GwPU6M308-4mn9flNm8__7Rk8ouX7I62TYu4ZgPF5c8) 100% of funds collected will go directly to victims and their families.

2. **If you’re in Texas, please consider donating blood.** The South Texas Blood and Tissue bank provided blood after the shooting and has [**_encouraged people to make a donation appointment_**](https://an.primarysinema.com/ss/c/SVVf6UGddUySPN6znLYVWqB6eCgv_e-8YLB-7ckXQoy42E5iWcGesjpfmzSbX69SOBDRNoUIfmTZFD3cWMr_dvbQJYvNIwjrQsU2BTHBRXc6IguGcxhGWlwWv1dENm6cpZvv96cyhsjFnl0BTZd5T8KzdSTbneu8Cyk9au-0PlZBiZHKiHIVy2JL_Ssmi4QtR_1q3xMlvQ6NoL0Jyn-E6hlmPDZHAfSYUBHh6NdZsEY8MQ0T1TibFYquLvy-6JZu1PQyqLFSipA4uGmKtXIQjw1B6BJK9Uy4g_M0ixHDmDg-DX5ZoEfVikRoDxldFn8pF7XRuXkK-_zk4Cnd1i3nYQ/3mf/LJ93xufdR3-L0A4KBjXg8g/h2/3kWYdTQ-A8X6znLK8snikSSAx2na46xi5JZnxhe880Q).

3. **Call Kyrsten Sinema’s Senate office at (202) 224-4521.** Don’t let her get a moment of peace until she drops her support for the filibuster so we can pass real gun reforms. We must call on our elected officials and demand that they fulfill their responsibility to act.

body:

| | | Fellow Patriot, Do you feel safer now than you were before the Left took over? I certainly don’t... nor do the thousands of innocent Americans from New York to Los Angeles who’ve become victims of the Biden crime wave. You and your family aren’t safer with radical activists like AOC and Ilhan Omar in Congress – instigating the domestic terrorists of BLM and Antifa to burn down our cities... You’re not safer with radical activist politicians dismantling our nation’s police departments... You’re not safer with scores of violent criminals being put back on the street and good cops being prosecuted for trying to do their jobs... And I’ll be damned if these progressive socialists continue to make it harder for good, honest, hard-working folks like you and me to live safely in our own communities. That’s why I’m asking you and every red-blooded American reading this email to help me restore law and order in America – once and for all... **[Can I count on you?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zis6tjtga57u46lleojuj9dita0lv67ggiffe8vg_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm2ob4cjh2bs)**

That’s no accident, friend. That’s what happens when socialists like AOC, Ilhan Omar, and Nancy Pelosi take over and intentionally tear the fabric of our country apart with their progressive policies and self-serving agendas. For the past two years, these kinds of leftists have stripped hundreds of millions of dollars from our nation’s police departments ... ... they’ve forced hundreds of good cops out of their careers and brought first responder morale to an all-time low... ... they’ve put thousands of violent criminals back onto the street while criminalizing cops for trying to do their jobs... And they wonder why crime in America is the highest it’s been since the 1980’s. Meanwhile, folks like you and me are afraid to leave our cars in the driveway or take our children out in public out of fear that we’ll be the next victims to make headline news. But here’s an even harsher truth... things aren’t magically going to get better. It’s up to folks like you and me to stand up, take action, and kick these progressives out of office. And I’m willing to take on the well-connected progressives who are orchestrating the complete destruction of our great country - no matter how deep their pockets are. But I can’t do it alone. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter, we wanted
to make sure you didn’t miss what Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez said earlier
this week about the Democratic Party and TX-28.

Nancy Pelosi and the establishment did everything they could to stop
Jessica Cisneros and re-elect anti-abortion, pro-NRA Henry Cuellar. This
can’t be the way forward for the Democratic Party.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/109844?refcode=em20220528-23571&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]Chip in $3 right now to help us fight the Democratic
establishment. We need all of our grassroots supporters behind our work to
ensure every vote is counted in TX-28.

Read our message from earlier this week below and donate if you can.

- Team JD

-----Forwarded Message-----
Sent: May 25, 2022
From: JusticeDemocrats.com
Subject: AOC on TX-28

Peter, the race
between Justice Democrat Jessica Cisneros and conservative Democrat Henry
Cuellar in TX-28 is too close to call. But Cuellar leads by 177 votes.

Nancy Pelosi and the Democratic Party did everything it could to stop
Jessica. As the votes came in last night, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez put
things into perspective:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/109844?refcode=em20220528-23571&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]Tweet from @AOC from 11:30pm on May 24, 2022 that reads On the day of a
mass shooting and weeks after news of Roe, Democratic Party leadership
rallied for a pro-NRA, anti-choice incumbent under investigation in a
close primary. Robocalls, fundraisers, all of it. Accountability isn’t
partisan. This was an utter failure of leadership.

Pelosi and the rest of House leadership went all in for the anti-choice,
NRA "A-rated" Cuellar. Cuellar is everything the Democratic Party SHOULD
oppose, yet he got fundraising support from leadership and Pelosi sent
robocalls directly to voters for Cuellar.

As AOC also said, Congress shouldn’t be an incumbent protection racket —
especially when the incumbent is against protecting abortion rights and
against stronger gun laws to reduce the rampant gun violence in this
country.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/109844?refcode=em20220528-23571&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]Peter,
this race isn’t over yet and we need the
grassroots support for whatever happens next. Can you rush a
$3 donation to Justice Democrats right now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/109844?refcode=em20220528-23571&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]Contribute

The corporate political establishment spent millions on those 177 votes.

Democratic mega-donor and billionaire Reid Hoffman’s "Mainstream Democrats
PAC" spent $750,000 against Jessica. The American Israel Public Affairs
Committee’s Super PAC spent $2 million to protect Cuellar. And that’s just
the beginning — Wall Street, Big Oil, and the Koch Brothers funded
Cuellar’s multi-million dollar campaign account.

The unlimited corporate money machine funding the political establishment
may have squeaked out this win for Cuellar with the help of the top four
Democrats in the House. All to stop Jessica, a progressive fighter who
wants Medicare for All, action to avert climate catastrophe, abortion
rights, and stronger gun laws. The Democratic establishment wanted to stop
progress for the people in this race.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/109844?refcode=em20220528-23571&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]Jessica may be headed to a recount and we need to be by her side every
step of the way. Can you chip in $3 right now so we can
stay strong for what’s next against the Democratic establishment?

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/109844?refcode=em20220528-23571&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1025&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]Contribute

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1026&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1027&akid=23571%2E1203867%2EOTUmFt ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

| | Friends, With Election Day only 10 days away, it is critical that we continue to spread the word about the campaign. The best way to do that is door knocking and distributing our literature. We have an app for iPhone or Android that can show you the homes in your neighborhood or county that we are targeting, and if you're interested in helping, and haven't been contacted by one of our coordinators for instructions on how to use it, please let me, know. If you have been contacted, it's a beautiful day to knock! I'll be out in northern Jones County and moving my way over to Lawrence County today.

If you need physical copies of literature, let me know where you live and I'll give you the best point of contact. Several people have asked for electronic copies of the literature we've been passing out so they can distribute to their own contacts. I've attached links to the front and back of the palm card we give out, as well as a flyer that is based on the information from the palm card. Feel free to distribute these at will! Thanks! We have an app for iPhone or Android that can show you the homes in your neighborhood or county that we are targeting, and if you're interested in helping, and haven't been contacted by one of our coordinators for instructions on how to use it, please let me, know. IL-3 - Litesa Wallace IL-17 | & MORE!

organizing can outmatch BIG money. Become a RECURRING DONOR to Our
Revolution right now to fund our voter outreach to put more progressive
allies in office!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5734?t=1012&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5734?t=1013&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ][IMG]

Minnesota Attorney General and Our Revolution Board Member Keith Ellison
joined our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5735?t=1014&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]National Organizing Call on Monday to talk about how to
communicate our progressive values to voters during the 2022 elections.

“We all want safety and security. Equality of the law means neither fear
nor favor — you hold folks accountable even if they’re wearing a badge,”
Keith said. “Part of our movement is trying to establish basic respect and
decency for all human beings.”

Keith said he’s expecting a tough race this year — like most progressives
across the country, he’s the target of the billionaires’ smear machine,
but we’ve overcome it before and we can do it again.

“One of our biggest obstacles is cynicism,” he said. “A lot of folks’
expectations were high — we do need real change and people want to see
things happen that affect their lives — and there have been failures on a
living wage, student debt relief, climate action. To achieve these things
— the time to fight is now, the time to grow our organizing is now.”

[ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=1015&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]Our movement needs you in these fights. We have a challenge ahead of
us, and we will win, but we have to stand up boldly for everyone’s right
to security and prosperity. Become a sustaining member today.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5734?t=1016&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

WOOOOO - CROCKETT VICTORY!

Our Revolution MEMBER Jasmine Crockett won the runoff Democratic primary
to win a seat in Congress representing the Dallas-area TX-30 District!

Jasmine beat a candidate endorsed by AIPAC and DMFI, former Biden Texas
director and Democratic Party insider, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5736?t=1018&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]Roll Call said, noting Our
Revolution’s endorsement.

Jasmine is a founding member of the Texas Progressive Caucus in the State
House, and she helped lead the walkout to block voting restrictions last
summer.

Now, she’s on her way to Washington in this blue district! [ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=1019&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]Help us keep
this momentum going and be a sustaining member of Our Revolution.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5734?t=1020&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ][IMG]

As of Wednesday, Our Revolution-endorsed Michelle Vallejo was leading her
Blue Dog opponent by just 23 votes in a close race for Congress in Texas’
15th District.

We are still waiting for the race to be called.

Running to represent one of the most uninsured regions of the country,
Michelle says Medicare for All would be “game-changing” for South Texans.
“No resident should have to cross the border to find affordable medical
care or treatments. No resident should have to rely on selling chicken
plates to cover medical expenses,” she said.

Michelle would make an amazing partner in Congress for our movement, and
we’re working to make sure this lead sticks!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5734?t=1021&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ][IMG]

The Texas-28 runoff between progressive Jessica Cisneros and Henry Cuellar
- one of the WORST “Democrats” in Congress - is still up in the air.

With an estimated 98 percent of the vote in on Wednesday, Cuellar was up
by just 177 votes.

“If Cuellar wins, leadership’s decision to go to the mat for a pro-NRA
incumbent will be the reason why,” Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez tweeted.

Speaker Nancy Pelosi and Majority Whip James Clyburn both ran recorded
robocalls right before the election backing Cuellar. Clyburn even visited
in person to campaign for Cuellar.

Our Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5737?t=1022&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]The Hill,
“Democratic leadership and countless corporate interests poured endless
fundraising support into the incumbent’s campaign to fit their
uninspiring, anti-progress mold,” he said. “It’s time for Washington to
wake up and recognize that working families want a progressive agenda.
It’s time to embrace and lift up pro-labor, pro-climate, pro-abortion
candidates, instead of actively working to defeat them.”

fighters on the ballot in Illinois, Nevada, New York, and around that
country that need our movement to help combat the establishment war on
progressives. Chip in now to help mount a unified front against their big
money.

NEW ENDORSEMENT!
LITESA WALLACE FOR CONGRESS, IL-17

We have a real progressive champion in Litesa Wallace, and Our Revolution
is proud to back her run for Congress to represent Illinois’ 17th
District.

Litesa was an original co-chair of Our Illinois Revolution and she’s been
a steadfast ally as IL State Rep, doing the work for affordable childcare,
mental healthcare, a living wage, violence reduction, and criminal justice
reform.

As a single mom and foster parent, Litesa knows what it’s like to work
hard and still struggle to make ends meet. She’s proud to have created a
Foster Children’s Bill of Rights while in the State House.

“People are tired, they want a government that works for them,” Litesa
told us on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5568?t=1025&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]National Organizing Call on Monday. “I won’t stop until
government works for all of us.”

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5734?t=1026&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ][IMG]

NEW ENDORSEMENT!
MIKE ORTEGA FOR CONGRESS, CA-46

Our Revolution is ready to work overtime to send Mike Ortega to Congress
to represent California’s 46th District. Early voting has started and
Election Day is June 7!

Mike is a lifelong organizer running an exciting campaign to get action on
our important progressive issues like Medicare for All and Canceling
Student Debt. “When I was in college I took out a student loan to help my
mother pay for medical care because for years she’d been rationing her
insulin,” he said. This is the America we live in.”

“People are ready for change. They’re tired of the same old stale
politics. That’s why we’re taking on Blue Dog Lou Correa - he’s for Big
Pharma, Big Oil, and Big Tech,” Mike told us on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5568?t=1027&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]National
Organizing Call on Monday. “This fight isn’t easy, and it’s not meant to
be easy.”

Mike’s district is a former Republic stronghold - now Bernie Sanders
territory — let’s get a serious movement partner in this seat. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5507?t=1028&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]Sign up
to phonebank for Mike Ortega!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5734?t=1029&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ][IMG]

NEW ENDORSEMENT!
DELIA RAMIREZ FOR CONGRESS, IL-3

Our Revolution is thrilled to endorse Illinois State Rep. Delia Ramirez
for Congress to represent Illinois’ 3rd. Voting is already underway and
Election Day is June 28th.

Delia is taking on the establishment as a committed ally in the fight for
Medicare for All, reproductive rights, climate action, and much more.

In the State House, she created a housing committee and expanded
affordable housing and Medicaid coverage. Delia was an early co-sponsor of
the state Clean Energy and Jobs Act and created an elected school board in
Chicago.

Before being elected, she founded and directed several community
organizations dedicated to creating prosperity for immigrants and
working-class neighborhoods.

“It’s incredible to see so many of us from the progressive movement
running at every level of government,” Delia said on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5568?t=1030&akid=2976%2E5885482%2EYdtsJJ ]National
Organizing Call on Monday. “If we get enough of us there, we will move the
needle.”
