No resident should have to rely on selling chicken plates to cover medical expenses,” she said. Michelle would make an amazing partner in Congress for our movement, and we’re working to make sure this lead sticks! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] The Texas-28 runoff between progressive Jessica Cisneros and Henry Cuellar - one of the WORST “Democrats” in Congress - is still up in the air. With an estimated 98 percent of the vote in on Wednesday, Cuellar was up by just 177 votes. “If Cuellar wins, leadership’s decision to go to the mat for a pro-NRA incumbent will be the reason why,” Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez tweeted. Speaker Nancy Pelosi and Majority Whip James Clyburn both ran recorded robocalls right before the election backing Cuellar. Clyburn even visited in person to campaign for Cuellar. Our Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese told [ ]The Hill, “Democratic leadership and countless corporate interests poured endless fundraising support into the incumbent’s campaign to fit their uninspiring, anti-progress mold,” he said. “It’s time for Washington to wake up and recognize that working families want a progressive agenda. It’s time to embrace and lift up pro-labor, pro-climate, pro-abortion candidates, instead of actively working to defeat them.” ★ ★ ★ [ ]Our fight is far from finished! This month, we have working-class fighters on the ballot in Illinois, Nevada, New York, and around that country that need our movement to help combat the establishment war on progressives. Chip in now to help mount a unified front against their big money. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] NEW ENDORSEMENT! LITESA WALLACE FOR CONGRESS, IL-17 We have a real progressive champion in Litesa Wallace, and Our Revolution is proud to back her run for Congress to represent Illinois’ 17th District. Litesa was an original co-chair of Our Illinois Revolution and she’s been a steadfast ally as IL State Rep, doing the work for affordable childcare, mental healthcare, a living wage, violence reduction, and criminal justice reform. As a single mom and foster parent, Litesa knows what it’s like to work hard and still struggle to make ends meet. She’s proud to have created a Foster Children’s Bill of Rights while in the State House. “People are tired, they want a government that works for them,” Litesa told us on our [ ]National Organizing Call on Monday. “I won’t stop until government works for all of us.” ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] NEW ENDORSEMENT! MIKE ORTEGA FOR CONGRESS, CA-46 Our Revolution is ready to work overtime to send Mike Ortega to Congress to represent California’s 46th District. Early voting has started and Election Day is June 7! Mike is a lifelong organizer running an exciting campaign to get action on our important progressive issues like Medicare for All and Canceling Student Debt. “When I was in college I took out a student loan to help my mother pay for medical care because for years she’d been rationing her insulin,” he said. This is the America we live in.” “People are ready for change. They’re tired of the same old stale politics. That’s why we’re taking on Blue Dog Lou Correa - he’s for Big Pharma, Big Oil, and Big Tech,” Mike told us on our [ ]National Organizing Call on Monday. “This fight isn’t easy, and it’s not meant to be easy.” Mike’s district is a former Republic stronghold - now Bernie Sanders territory — let’s get a serious movement partner in this seat. [ ]Sign up to phonebank for Mike Ortega! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] NEW ENDORSEMENT! DELIA RAMIREZ FOR CONGRESS, IL-3 Our Revolution is thrilled to endorse Illinois State Rep. Delia Ramirez for Congress to represent Illinois’ 3rd. Voting is already underway and Election Day is June 28th. Delia is taking on the establishment as a committed ally in the fight for Medicare for All, reproductive rights, climate action, and much more. In the State House, she created a housing committee and expanded affordable housing and Medicaid coverage. Delia was an early co-sponsor of the state Clean Energy and Jobs Act and created an elected school board in Chicago. Before being elected, she founded and directed several community organizations dedicated to creating prosperity for immigrants and working-class neighborhoods. “It’s incredible to see so many of us from the progressive movement running at every level of government,” Delia said on our [ ]National Organizing Call on Monday. “If we get enough of us there, we will move the needle.” ★ ★ ★ [ ]Rush a donation now to help elect these powerful progressive candidates and counter the corrosive effect of big money in politics! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] BIG WIN TO DEFEND DEMOCRACY! In a major victory for our movement, a federal appeals court ruled Tuesday that the US Constitution's “Insurrectionist Disqualification Clause” trumps a Civil War-era Amnesty Law and that our campaign to ban January 6th insurrectionists from the ballot is on solid ground legally, [ ]CNN reported. With the J6 hearings starting in June, Our Revolution members and our partners at Free Speech For People are ramping up our campaign in the courts and on the streets. Our members are calling on state election officials to use their power under the Constitution to bar criminal insurrectionists like Trump, Doug Mastriano, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Paul Gosar who aided and incited the mob that breached the Capitol on January 6th! [ ]Sign our petition to your state elections official demanding they uphold the Constitution and bar insurrectionists from the ballot. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] “Democrats shouldn’t have to agree on ‘everything,’ but it’s hardly ‘sophomoric’ to suggest they stand for something,” writes Robert Borosage in [ ]The Nation. In race after race - from Nina Turner v. Shontel Brown to Cuellar v. Cisneros - Borosage points out that the Democratic Party’s corporate-funded campaign arms like the DCCC and the DSCC - are thumbing their noses at the Party platform - and the people - by putting their thumbs on the scale in favor of moderates who align with corporate interests and against popular progressive priorities. But all is not lost, as the results of the election make clear. Borosage writes that groups like Our Revolution are building an “independent infrastructure” outside of the party that is effectively fighting to make sure that the Democratic Party is truly democratic. [ ]READ MORE HERE ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution Trenton/Mercer Counties (New Jersey) is fielding a slate of progressive Dem County Committee candidates across Mercer County. We are proud that our members are stepping up to represent their communities and transform the party from the bottom up! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] As we showed this week with the victories of Jasmine Crockett and possibly Michelle Vallejo, we can overcome the force of big money by reaching voters directly. We have a shot to elect more allies and replace more #ManchinDems in these pivotal primaries — if we continue to rise up as a unified front and outmatch corporate power. Help us make calls any day of the week for Our Revolution partners like Alexi Giannoulias for Illinois Secretary of State, and congressional candidates Andy Levin (MI-11), Brittany Ramos DeBarros (NY-11), David Segal (RI-2), Amy Vilela (NV-1), and DC Council candidates Erin Palmer and Zack Parker. Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. name: Giffords
subject: It’s not the doors. It’s the guns.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Yesterday afternoon, Donald Trump spoke at the NRA convention and delivered an all-too predictable response.
#

Friends --
Yesterday afternoon, Donald Trump spoke at the NRA convention and delivered an all-too predictable response.
We need to arm teachers, he said. We need to harden schools. He said every school should have one door to enter. We need fences and metal detectors, he said.
But here is the truth:
It’s not the doors. It’s not mental health. It’s not video games or fences. It’s not about arming teachers or the layout of schools.
It’s the guns.
Specifically, it’s the access to guns by people who shouldn’t have them—and it’s the weapons of war we allow to be carried on our streets by 18-year-olds.
The United States of America is not the only country in the world that has more than one door in their schools.
The United States is not the only country in the world that has people who have mental health problems, or who play video games.
But the United States IS the only country that suffers through these kinds of mass shootings with this kind of regularity.
And that is because we are the only country in the world whose leaders refuse to take the steps we need to keep people safe from gun violence.
In 2022, we have a choice: either Congress can act to make our communities safer from gun violence, or we must elect a Congress that will.
That is our top priority at Giffords PAC, and we’re asking for your help to get it done:

name: Gary Sinise
subject: Most don't know this about Memorial Day
body:
This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5g3lsv2mj499agq702bpoj5q2jh8kgmh3gi0pig_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcddm68qe0s70cpo63c9mmdqm6dr5eiqb7cj4m3gb6shh6iqn8p1nc9h6fcdge3jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8pmccbgmmq6fdj2coq61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvu131a8e3n4doqbnj3ots0dftphc3j60ptrhgv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
Fellow American, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Fellow American, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2fe4e55l0fpejjefeg33c5ras8gf3qdoo1rr8n8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5n89l9dvn6vqlob6rsm91t3i01kjgi3cv4hg4o0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcm4bea4hi75vpui9scp78l9uio3acdok737fk3g_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation’s heroes deserve.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq0qpu0n4oroerc4h57btccjp1mtg4bqthsi6uag_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg84j8bnjinh8jd70c41aa27ukubg9f0ia4efh28_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsiphtqfuc735n9kbpch4h22ddn5836ben25qkc0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrjbm8aa776bcqqhtdbcgjuuvmva6o2c5sqnb2c8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs) But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.

On Memorial Day — this year and every year — please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans’ cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more._ Fellow American, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please — [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zasca2nf7f357ht7400q6i5aq7rhkenojb7njvo0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cthm1o32c1h2bs)
---
Sincerely,

Gary Sinise
Honorary Grand Marshal
National Memorial Day Parade
---

---

clean_body: This fight is not over. | | | Peter, We’re still in this campaign because our movement came together to support this campaign with grassroots contributions and volunteering. Our fight is not over yet. Kina Collins is running a grassroots campaign to take on the political machine in IL-07. I am proud to support her campaign and I am so thankful that Kina and her team supported our campaign by making calls to voters to help defeat Henry Cuellar. Kina’s primary is in exactly 1 month and she needs the resources to reach voters all across Chicago. Kina witnessed a shooting in front of her home on the West Side of Chicago when she was a child. As a survivor, organizer and activist, she has fought her whole life to stop the gun violence in her community and across the country. She led the largest gun violence prevention organization in Illinois. Kina will be a progressive champion for the people of IL-07. Like myself, Kina has been endorsed by Justice Democrats and Sunrise Movement. Showing up for her community is who Kina is. Whether it was the fight to oppose Rahm Emanuel accountable or standing with organizers, union workers, and gun violence survivors every week. Kina will always choose to stand with her community. The people of IL-07 deserve a representative who will fight for them, not corporations. And that’s Kina. Thank you, Jessica Cisneros | To give by check: PO Box 660 Laredo, TX 78042

Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [The Speaker Toppled](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziopM4VuGJKF9DjGCkBjxNlGzLVLCf-sNUNIMtq6YoxqfyQ&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may28_final&n=1) Yesterday, the Speaker of the Assembly ignored our bipartisan letter to let the gas tax bill pass. In other news, yesterday the Speaker was toppled. The position of Assembly Speaker is equivalent to Pelosi’s role in D.C. For six years, it’s been held by a guy named Anthony Rendon. But now Democrat Assemblyman Robert Rivas claims he “has the votes” to overthrow Rendon. The Assembly may vote on the matter Tuesday. As the Democrats fight amongst themselves, I’m proposing a third option: Speaker James Gallagher. While sadly that's unlikely, the warring Democrat factions are awkwardly approaching Republicans to court our votes and try to make a deal. Things could get interesting. Meanwhile, the “State of Emergency” continues even as Californians simply ignore Newsom. Orange County's Board of Education sued the Governor to end it, and just received “responses” to questions he had to answer under oath: **INTERROGATORY 1****:** Identify the objective criteria you are relying on to determine when to end the COVID State of Emergency. **NEWSOM RESPONSE** : "Defendant declines to respond to this Interrogatory." ******INTERROGATORY 2****:** Identify any standards provided by the California Legislature that you have relied on to determine when to end the COVID State of Emergency. **NEWSOM RESPONSE** : "Defendant declines to respond to this Interrogatory." **INTERROGATORY 3****:** Identify any standards in the Emergency Services Act that you have relied on to determine when to end the COVID State of Emergency. **NEWSOM RESPONSE** : "Defendant declines to respond to this Interrogatory." This has a familiar ring to me, having taken on Newsom in court for almost a year. Despite such stonewalling tactics, we won our trial against him. I’m hopeful the OC Board will win theirs. body:
This is why we must keep fighting. We cannot take anything for granted.
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60479697:6x2t3norN:m:1:3253819041:130EF76D9C8FBC96341392EB523888CE:r)
---
Peter,
---
Nothing is certain yet.
---
While Justice Roberts confirmed the authenticity of the leaked Supreme Court draft opinion overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , _he also declared that the opinion is**NOT** final_.
---
_The Big Abortion Lobby took Roberts ' clarification as an opportunity to pressure, intimidate, and threaten the 5 justices as a last-ditch effort to keep Roe intact. _
---
**SBA List has been fighting back against the pro-abortion pressure campaign aimed at the 5 justices who want to protect the constitutional rights of unborn children.**
---
_But now, with the FIRST end-of-month deadline coming up since the draft was leaked, we need your help fighting back._

body:
We have to win political power. There is no other option.
#
Following the tragedy in Uvalde, Beto took a break from campaigning to be on the ground with this community. We also halted our fundraising efforts, including emails like this one asking for grassroots donations. It was the right thing to do as we focused on supporting those in Uvalde and people across Texas.
But the reality is that if we want to finally save lives and get our state on the right track, then we have to win political power. There is no other option.
[Will you contribute $3 right now to help Beto defeat Greg Abbott? If we want to put the people of this state first, then we have to do everything possible to win this race.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220528?refcode=ema20220528-191401&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&refcode2=191401_444211_A9cfIc&akid=191401%2E444211%2EA9cfIc)
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220528?refcode=ema20220528-191401&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&refcode2=191401_444211_A9cfIc&akid=191401%2E444211%2EA9cfIc)**
Greg Abbott has spent the last seven years hurting the people of Texas. He has outright refused to put the lives and livelihoods of Texans first — from his deadly power grid failure and his foster care crisis in which kids have been trafficked, to his attacks on teachers, transgender kids, and a woman’s freedom to control her own body, health care, and future.
Abbott’s objection to taking any meaningful action to prevent mass shootings across our state — after Santa Fe High, after Sutherland Springs, after El Paso — only makes it more clear than ever that the only way to help the people he’s hurting is to win this election.
But it’s on all of us to make that possible. That’s why we’re building the biggest organizing program that Texas has ever seen in order to reach millions of voters, bring new people into our campaign, and win this race.
[Instead of relying on corporate PACs and NRA checks to fund our campaign, we’re relying on support from people like you. Please make a $3 contribution right now to help Beto defeat Greg Abbott and finally put the people of this state first.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220528?refcode=ema20220528-191401&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=191401_444211_A9cfIc&akid=191401%2E444211%2EA9cfIc)
Together, we will keep standing up, keep organizing, and keep fighting.
More soon,
Team Beto
